Complete schema reference

Every vendored OpenAIX schema and every org.opord-builder.* extension schema. Each type has a field table. Generated by opord docs; do not edit.

openAIX OPORD

urn:openaix:schema:opord:0.2.0-draft.1

opord

An operation order (OPORD) is a directive that coordinates the execution of an operation, in five paragraphs with annexes. The structure follows FM 5-0 and FM 6-0.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
$schemastring (uri)This field identifies the schema that validates this document.
acknowledgementAcknowledgementThis field gives the acknowledgement instructions.
annexesAnnexesThis field gives the annexes, by letter.
authenticationAuthenticationThis field gives the signature block.
command_and_signalCommandAndSignalThis field gives paragraph 5 (Command and Signal).
date_timeDateTimeThis field gives the time of signature of the order.
effective_timeDateTimeThis field gives the time of the start of the effect of the order.
executionExecutionThis field gives paragraph 3 (Execution).
extensionsExtensions & anyThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record. The namespace org.opord-builder.print contains the data that opord-builder puts on each page.
issuing_headquartersstringThis field gives the name of the headquarters that publishes the order, as free text.
kind"opord"yesThe value identifies this record as an operation order (OPORD).
metaMetadataThis field gives the identification, revision and issue data of this document.
missionMissionParagraphyesThis field gives paragraph 2 (Mission).
operation_namestringThis field gives the code name of the operation, as free text.
order_numberstringThis field gives the number of the order, such as 26-01, as free text.
ordersOrderLinksThis field gives the air tasking order (ATO), airspace control order (ACO) and special instructions (SPINS) of the order.
periodPeriodThis field gives the time interval during which the operation occurs.
referenceslist of DocumentRefThis list contains the maps, charts and documents that the order refers to.
resources_refResourceRefThis field identifies the resource catalogue that resolves the references of this order.
schema_version"0.2.0-draft.1"yesThis field gives the version of the openAIX schema that this document agrees with.
situationSituationThis field gives paragraph 1 (Situation).
sustainmentSustainmentThis field gives paragraph 4 (Sustainment).
task_organizationmap of UnitThis map contains the units of the task organization. The key of each item is its identifier.
time_zonestringThis field gives the letter of the time zone that the order uses for display, such as Z. Each time in the document contains an offset.

Acknowledgement

An acknowledgement is the instructions for the acknowledgement of the order.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
acknowledgebooleanyesThe value is true when each addressee acknowledges the order.
instructionsstringThis field gives the instructions for the acknowledgement, as free text.

AdjacentUnit

An adjacent unit is one adjacent unit and its mission.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
agencyIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that controls the adjacent unit.
boundaryIdentifierThis field identifies the control measure that is the boundary with the adjacent unit.
directionenumThis field gives the direction from this unit to the adjacent unit, as one of the enumerated values.
  • north
  • north_east
  • east
  • south_east
  • south
  • south_west
  • west
  • north_west
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this adjacent unit. Each adjacent unit in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this adjacent unit.
missionstringThis field gives the mission of the adjacent unit, as free text.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this adjacent unit, for display.

Agreement

An agreement is one agreement with the host nation.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
effectiveWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the agreement is in effect.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this agreement. Each agreement in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this agreement.
kindenumyesThis field gives the type of the agreement, as one of the enumerated values.
  • status_of_forces
  • acquisition_cross_servicing
  • technical
  • other
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this agreement, for display.
partieslist of stringThis list contains the organizations that sign the agreement.

AirDefenseAppendix

An appendix for air and missile defence is Appendix 7 (Air and Missile Defense) of Annex D. FM 6-0 (2022) puts these data in Annex D. FM 5-0 (2024) puts them in a different annex, Annex I, which openAIX does not use.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
defended_assetslist of DefendedAssetThis list contains the defended assets, in order.
engagement_authoritieslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the command and control agencies that have engagement authority.
measureslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the control measures that are air defence measures.
warningslist of AirDefenseWarningThis list contains the air defence warnings.
weapons_controllist of WeaponsControlThis list contains the weapons control orders.

AirDefenseWarning

An air defence warning is one air defence warning for an area and a time interval.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
levelenumyesThis field gives the air defence warning, as one of the enumerated values.
  • white
  • yellow
  • red
measureIdentifierThis field identifies the control measure that gives the area of the air defence warning.
windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the air defence warning is in effect.

AirSupportAppendix

An air support appendix is Appendix 5 (Air Support) of Annex D.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
agencieslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the command and control agencies that control air support.
ato_missionslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that give air interdiction and air reconnaissance. The orders field identifies the ATO.
cas_allocationslist of CasAllocationThis list contains the close air support (CAS) allocations.
cas_briefslist of CasBriefThis list contains the close air support (CAS) briefs that the staff writes before the mission. Each brief has the 9-line data of JP 3-09.3.
pointslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the points that are contact points, initial points and holding points for air support. Each point shall have the role control or initial or marshalling.

AirspaceAppendix

An airspace appendix is Appendix 10 (Airspace) of Annex C.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
agencieslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the command and control agencies that control parts of the airspace.
airspace_control_agencyIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that controls the airspace.
coordinating_altitudeIdentifierThis field identifies the control measure that gives the coordinating altitude.
measureslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the control measures that are airspace coordinating measures.
summarystringThis field gives the summary of the airspace plan, as free text.

Annexes

Annexes are the annexes of the order, by letter. The order shall not have an annex with the letter I, O, T, X or Y.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
ATaskOrganizationAnnexThis field gives the annex for task organization.
BIntelligenceAnnexThis field gives the annex for intelligence.
COperationsAnnexThis field gives the annex for operations.
DFiresAnnexThis field gives the annex for fires.
EProtectionAnnexThis field gives the annex for protection.
FSustainmentAnnexThis field gives the annex for sustainment.
GEngineerAnnexThis field gives the annex for engineer.
HSignalAnnexThis field gives the annex for signal.
JPublicAffairsAnnexThis field gives the annex for public affairs.
KCivilAffairsAnnexThis field gives the annex for civil affairs operations.
LInformationCollectionAnnexThis field gives the annex for information collection.
MAssessmentAnnexThis field gives the annex for assessment.
NSpaceOperationsAnnexThis field gives the annex for space operations.
PHostNationSupportAnnexThis field gives the annex for host-nation support.
QKnowledgeManagementAnnexThis field gives the annex for knowledge management.
RReportsAnnexThis field gives the annex for reports.
SSpecialTechnicalOperationsAnnexThis field gives the annex for special technical operations.
UInspectorGeneralAnnexThis field gives the annex for inspector general.
VInteragencyCoordinationAnnexThis field gives the annex for interagency coordination.
WOperationalContractSupportAnnexThis field gives the annex for operational contract support.
ZDistributionAnnexThis field gives the annex for distribution.

AreaOfInterest

An area of interest is the area of interest of the operation, as control measures.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
measureslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the control measures that give the area of interest.
summarystringThis field gives the summary of the area of interest, as free text.

AreaOfOperations

An area of operations is the area of operations of the unit, with its terrain and weather.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
measureslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the control measures that give the area of operations and its boundaries.
summarystringThis field gives the summary of the area of operations, as free text.
terrainTerrainThis field gives the terrain data of the area of operations.
weatherWeatherThis field gives the weather data of the area of operations.

AssessmentAnnex

An annex for assessment is the annex with the letter M in the order.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
measures_of_effectivenesslist of EffectivenessMeasureThis list contains the measure of effectiveness (MOE) entries.
measures_of_performancelist of PerformanceMeasureThis list contains the measure of performance (MOP) entries.
reframing_criterialist of ObjectiveThis list contains the conditions that cause the staff to change the plan.
remarksstringThis field gives the remarks about Annex M, as free text.
summarystringThis field gives the summary of Annex M, as free text.

AssistancePoint

An inspector general office is one office where personnel can speak to the inspector general.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
channelIdentifierThis field identifies the radio channel that the office refers to.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this point. Each point in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this point.
positionGeoPointThis field gives the geographic position of the office, as latitude and longitude.
unitIdentifierThis field identifies the unit of the task organization that operates the office.
windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the office is open.

Assumption

An assumption is one assumption of the plan.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
assumptionstringyesThis field gives the assumption, as free text.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this assumption. Each assumption in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this assumption.

AttachmentDetachment

An attachment or detachment is one change of the headquarters of a unit.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
actionenumyesThis field gives the type of the change, attachment or detachment, as one of the enumerated values.
  • attach
  • detach
effectiveDateTimeThis field gives the time of the change.
headquartersstringThis field gives the name of the headquarters that receives or releases the unit, as free text.
phaseIdentifierThis field identifies the phase of the operation that the change occurs in.
relationshipenumThis field gives the command or support relationship after the change, as one of the enumerated values.
  • organic
  • assigned
  • attached
  • operational_control
  • tactical_control
  • administrative_control
  • direct_support
  • reinforcing
  • general_support_reinforcing
  • general_support
unitIdentifieryesThis field identifies the unit of the task organization that goes to a different headquarters.

Authentication

An authentication is the signature block of the order.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
authenticator_namestringThis field gives the name of the staff officer who authenticates the order, as free text.
authenticator_positionstringThis field gives the position of the staff officer who authenticates the order, as free text.
commander_namestringyesThis field gives the last name of the commander, as free text.
commander_rankstringThis field gives the rank of the commander, as free text.

AvenueOfApproach

An avenue of approach is one avenue of approach for a force of one echelon.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
directionenumThis field gives the direction of movement on the avenue of approach, as one of the enumerated values.
  • north
  • north_east
  • east
  • south_east
  • south
  • south_west
  • west
  • north_west
echelonenumThis field gives the largest echelon that the avenue of approach can hold, as one of the enumerated values.
  • team
  • squad
  • section
  • platoon
  • company
  • battalion
  • regiment
  • brigade
  • division
  • corps
  • army
  • flight
  • squadron
  • group
  • wing
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this avenue of approach. Each avenue of approach in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this avenue of approach.
measureslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the control measures that give the path of the avenue of approach.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this avenue of approach, for display.

BattleRhythmEvent

A battle rhythm event is one meeting, board, report or update in the battle rhythm.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
attendeeslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the units of the task organization that are at the event.
chairIdentifierThis field identifies the unit of the task organization that controls the event.
channelIdentifierThis field identifies the radio channel that the event refers to.
duration_minutesintegerThis field gives the length of the event, in minutes.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this event. Each event in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this event.
interval_minutesintegerThis field gives the time between two events, in minutes.
kindenumyesThis field gives the type of the event, as one of the enumerated values.
  • meeting
  • board
  • working_group
  • update
  • report
  • briefing
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this event, for display.
startDateTimeyesThis field gives the time of the first event.

CCIR

Commander's critical information requirements are the priority intelligence requirement (PIR) and friendly force information requirement (FFIR) lists.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
friendly_force_information_requirementslist of InformationRequirementThis list contains the friendly force information requirement (FFIR) entries, in order.
priority_intelligence_requirementslist of InformationRequirementThis list contains the priority intelligence requirement (PIR) entries, in order.

CallSign

A call sign is one call sign of a unit or an agency for a time interval.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
agencyIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that uses the call sign.
callsignstringyesThis field gives the call sign, as free text.
unitIdentifierThis field identifies the unit of the task organization that uses the call sign.
windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the call sign is in effect.

CasAllocation

A close air support (CAS) allocation is the CAS for one supported unit.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
ato_missionslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that give the close air support (CAS). The orders field identifies the ATO.
phaseIdentifierThis field identifies the phase of the operation that the allocation is applicable to.
sortiesintegerThis field gives the number of close air support (CAS) sorties.
unitIdentifieryesThis field identifies the unit of the task organization that receives the close air support (CAS).
windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the close air support (CAS) is available.

CivilAffairsAnnex

Annex for civil affairs operations are the annex with the letter K in the order.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
centreslist of CivilMilitaryCentreThis list contains the civil-military operations centres.
dislocated_civilian_routeslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the routes of the resource catalogue for dislocated civilians.
protected_siteslist of ProtectedSiteThis list contains the protected sites.
remarksstringThis field gives the remarks about Annex K, as free text.
summarystringThis field gives the summary of Annex K, as free text.
taskslist of TaskThis list contains the tasks of the execution matrix.

CivilConsideration

An entry of the civil considerations is one entry of the civil considerations, with its areas, structures, capabilities, organizations, people and events (ASCOPE) class.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
categoryenumyesThis field gives the areas, structures, capabilities, organizations, people and events (ASCOPE) class of the entry, as one of the enumerated values.
  • areas
  • structures
  • capabilities
  • organizations
  • people
  • events
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this entry. Each entry in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this entry.
measureIdentifierThis field identifies the control measure that gives the area of the entry.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this entry, for display.
positionGeoPointThis field gives the geographic position of the entry, as latitude and longitude.
significancestringThis field gives the effect of the entry on the operation, as free text.
windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the event occurs.

CivilConsiderations

Civil considerations are the very important parts of the situation of the population.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
entrieslist of CivilConsiderationThis list contains the civil considerations.
summarystringThis field gives the summary of the situation of the population, as free text.

CivilMilitaryCentre

A civil-military operations centre is one centre for coordination with organizations of the population.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
channelIdentifierThis field identifies the radio channel that the centre refers to.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this centre. Each centre in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this centre.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this centre, for display.
positionGeoPointThis field gives the geographic position of the centre, as latitude and longitude.
unitIdentifierThis field identifies the unit of the task organization that operates the centre.

CloudLayer

A cloud layer is one layer of cloud, with its coverage, its base and its tops.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
baseAltitudeyesThis field gives the base of the layer, as an altitude with its unit and reference.
coverageenumyesThis field gives the part of the sky that the layer covers, as one of the enumerated values.
  • clear
  • few
  • scattered
  • broken
  • overcast
topsAltitudeThis field gives the tops of the layer, as an altitude with its unit and reference.

CollectionTask

A collection task is one row of the information collection plan.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
ato_missionIdentifierThis field identifies the mission of the air tasking order (ATO) that does the task. The orders field identifies the ATO.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this task. Each task in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this task.
indicatorstringThis field gives the indicator that the task looks for, as free text.
measureIdentifierThis field identifies the control measure that is the named area of interest of the task.
reportIdentifierThis field identifies the report of the resource catalogue that gives the results of the task.
report_toIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that receives the reports.
requirementIdentifierThis field identifies the information requirement that the task gives data for.
unitIdentifierThis field identifies the unit of the task organization that does the task.
windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the task is in effect.

Command

Command is the location of the leaders and the succession of command.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
leaderslist of LeaderLocationThis list contains the locations of the commander and key leaders.
liaisonlist of LiaisonThis list contains the liaison requirements.
successionlist of IdentifierThis list identifies the units of the task organization. The list gives the succession of command, in order.

CommandAndSignal

Command and signal is paragraph 5 of the order.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
commandCommandThis field gives the command data.
command_postslist of CommandPostThis list contains the command posts.
signalSignalThis field gives the signal data.

CommandPost

A command post is one command post, its location and the time when it operates.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
agencyIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that the command post operates as.
controlslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the phases of the operation that the command post controls.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this command post. Each command post in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this command post.
kindenumyesThis field gives the type of the command post, as one of the enumerated values.
  • main
  • tactical
  • rear
  • support_area
  • early_entry
  • mobile_command_group
  • alternate
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this command post, for display.
operationalWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the command post operates.
positionGeoPointThis field gives the geographic position of the command post, as latitude and longitude.
unitIdentifierThis field identifies the unit of the task organization that the command post is for.

CommandRelationship

A command relationship is the command or support relationship of one unit.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
effectiveDateTimeThis field gives the time of the start of the entry.
headquartersstringThis field gives the name of the other headquarters of the entry, when it is not in the task organization, as free text.
phaseIdentifierThis field identifies the phase of the operation that the entry is applicable to.
relationshipenumyesThis field gives the command relationship or support relationship, as one of the enumerated values.
  • organic
  • assigned
  • attached
  • operational_control
  • tactical_control
  • administrative_control
  • direct_support
  • reinforcing
  • general_support_reinforcing
  • general_support
toIdentifierThis field identifies the unit of the task organization that is the other unit of the entry.
unitIdentifieryesThis field identifies the unit of the task organization that the entry is for.

CommandersIntent

A commander's intent is the purpose, key tasks and end state of the operation.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
end_stateEndStateThis field gives the end state.
key_taskslist of KeyTaskThis list contains the key tasks.
purposestringyesThis field gives the expanded purpose of the operation, as free text.

ConceptOfOperations

A concept of operations is the sequence of tasks of the force, with its main effort, areas and phases.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
close_areaIdentifierThis field identifies the control measure that gives the close area.
deep_areaIdentifierThis field identifies the control measure that gives the deep area.
main_effortIdentifierThis field identifies the unit of the task organization that is the main effort.
phaseslist of PhaseThis list contains the phases of the operation, in order.
rear_areaIdentifierThis field identifies the control measure that gives the rear area.
reserveIdentifierThis field identifies the unit of the task organization that is the reserve.
summarystringThis field gives the summary of the concept of operations, as free text.
supporting_effortslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the units of the task organization that are supporting efforts of the operation.

ContractRequirement

A contract support requirement is one requirement that contractors support.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
airfieldIdentifierThis field identifies the airfield that the support is at.
categoryenumyesThis field gives the type of contract support, as one of the enumerated values.
  • theater_support
  • external_support
  • systems_support
contractorstringThis field gives the name of the contractor, as free text.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this requirement. Each requirement in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this requirement.
positionGeoPointThis field gives the geographic position of the support, as latitude and longitude.
requirementstringyesThis field gives the requirement, as free text.
unitslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the units of the task organization that receive the support.
windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the contract is in effect.

ContractingOffice

A contracting office is one office that makes and controls contracts.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
channelIdentifierThis field identifies the radio channel that the office refers to.

namestringyesThis field gives the name of this office, for display.
positionGeoPointThis field gives the geographic position of the office, as latitude and longitude.
unitIdentifierThis field identifies the unit of the task organization that operates the office.

CoordinatingInstructions

airspace_coordinating_measureslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the control measures that are airspace coordinating measures that two or more units use.

personnel_recoveryPersonnelRecoveryMeasuresThis field gives the measures for personnel recovery.
risk_reductionRiskReductionThis field gives the risk reduction measures.
rules_of_engagementlist of RoeRuleThis list contains the rules of engagement (ROE).
themes_and_messageslist of MessageThis list contains the themes and messages.
timelinelist of TimelineEventThis list contains the very important times and events, in order.

DecisionPoint

latest_timeDateTimeThis field gives the time of the last time at which the commander makes the decision.

namestringyesThis field gives the name of this asset, for display.
positionGeoPointThis field gives the geographic position of the asset, as latitude and longitude.
priorityintegeryesThis field gives the priority of this entry. The value 1 is the highest priority.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
recipientslist of RecipientThis list contains the recipients.

EndState

FieldTypeRequiredDescription

openAIX FRAGO

urn:openaix:schema:frago:0.2.0-draft.1

frago

A fragmentary order (FRAGO) is an order that changes one or more identified orders. The orders are an operation order (OPORD), an air tasking order (ATO), an airspace control order (ACO) or a special instructions (SPINS) publication. It contains only the changes, as JSON Pointer changes to one identified revision.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
$schemastring (uri)This field identifies the schema that validates this document.
acknowledgementAcknowledgementThis field gives the acknowledgement instructions.
authenticationAuthenticationThis field gives the signature block.
base_orderOrderRefyesThis field identifies the base order that this fragmentary order (FRAGO) changes. The reference gives the identifier and the revision, not a file path.
changeslist of OrderChangeThis list contains the changes, in order. A consumer makes the changes in the sequence of the list. Validation examines only the structure, and consumers make the changes.
commanders_intentstringThis field gives the changed intent of the commander, as free text.
date_timeDateTimeyesThis field gives the time of signature of the fragmentary order (FRAGO).
effective_timeDateTimeThis field gives the time of the start of the effect of the fragmentary order (FRAGO).
extensionsExtensions & anyThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record. The namespace org.opord-builder.print contains the data that opord-builder puts on each page.
frago_numberstringyesThis field gives the number of the fragmentary order (FRAGO), such as 01, as free text.
issuing_headquartersstringThis field gives the name of the headquarters that publishes the fragmentary order (FRAGO), as free text.
kind"frago"yesThe value identifies this record as a fragmentary order (FRAGO).
metaMetadataThis field gives the identification, revision and issue data of this document.
missionstringThis field gives the changed mission statement, as free text.
referenceslist of DocumentRefThis list contains the documents that the fragmentary order (FRAGO) refers to.
schema_version"0.2.0-draft.1"yesThis field gives the version of the openAIX schema that this document agrees with.
summarystringThis field gives the summary of the fragmentary order (FRAGO), as free text.
time_zonestringThis field gives the letter of the time zone that the order uses for display, such as Z. Each time in the document contains an offset.

Acknowledgement

An acknowledgement is the instructions for the acknowledgement of the order.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
acknowledgebooleanyesThe value is true when each addressee acknowledges the order.
instructionsstringThis field gives the instructions for the acknowledgement, as free text.

Authentication

An authentication is the signature block of the order.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription

authenticator_positionstringThis field gives the position of the staff officer who authenticates the order, as free text.
commander_namestringyesThis field gives the last name of the commander, as free text.
commander_rankstringThis field gives the rank of the commander, as free text.

kindenumyesThis field gives the type of the order, as one of the enumerated values.
  • opord
  • ato
  • aco
  • spins
revisionstringyesThis field gives the revision of the order that the change is for.

OrderChange

A change is one change to an identified order.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
openumyesThis field gives the operation of the change, as one of the enumerated values.
  • add
  • replace
  • remove
pathstringyesThis field gives the location of the change, as a JSON Pointer of RFC 6901.
remarksstringThis field gives the remarks about the change, as free text.
targetChangeTargetyesThis field identifies the order that the change is for.
valueanyThis field gives the new value at the location. An add or replace change shall have this field. A remove change shall not have this field.

OrderRef

An order reference is the identifier and the revision of one order.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies the order that this reference is for. The value is the meta.id field of the order.
revisionstringyesThis field gives the revision of the order. The value is the meta.revision field of the order.

PrintExtension

A print extension is the page data that opord-builder puts on each printed page of the order. The namespace is org.opord-builder.print, and the group is for this application only.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
classification_bannerClassificationLevelThis field gives the classification marking on the top and the bottom of each page.
classification_caveatstringThis field gives the dissemination caveat after the classification marking, such as REL TO USA, FVEY, as free text.
copy_numberintegerThis field gives the number of this copy in the distribution. The number should not be more than number_of_copies.
logostringThis field gives the path or the web address of the logo for the cover page.
message_reference_numberstringThis field gives the message reference number that the originator gives to the order, as free text.
number_of_copiesintegerThis field gives the number of copies in the distribution.
page_iconstringThis field gives the path or the web address of the icon for the header of each page.
place_of_issuestringThis field gives the place where the order is issued, as free text.
watermarkstringThis field gives the watermark of each page: short text such as DRAFT, or the path or the web address of an image.

openAIX SPINS

urn:openaix:schema:spins:0.2.0-draft.1

spins

Special instructions (SPINS) are a publication that adds procedures, restrictions and coordination instructions to the tasking of all missions. It contains permanent instructions, or changes to a base publication with a pinned reference.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
$schemastring (uri)This field identifies the schema that validates this document.
air_defenseSpinsAirDefenseThis field gives the air defence procedures.
airspace_noteslist of AirspaceNoteThis list contains the airspace notes.
basePinnedRefThis field identifies the base publication that this publication changes. The reference identifies one revision of the publication.
casSpinsCasThis field gives the close air support (CAS) stacks, the laser code plan and the laser restrictions.
changeslist of PublicationChangeThis list contains the changes to the base publication, in order. A consumer makes the changes in the sequence of the list.
check_inlist of CheckInProcedureThis list contains the procedures for each agency at the start and at the end of a task.
communicationsSpinsCommunicationsThis field gives the radio nets and the brevity words.
divert_and_abortSpinsDivertAbortThis field gives the abort conditions and the divert airfields.
electromagneticSpinsElectromagneticThis field gives the emission control periods and the jamming coordination.
emergencySpinsEmergencyThis field gives the emergency procedures.
extensionsExtensions & anyThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record. The namespace org.opord-builder.print contains the data that opord-builder puts on each page.
identificationSpinsIdentificationThis field gives the identification, friend or foe (IFF) assignments and code words.
kind"spins"yesThe value identifies this record as a special instructions (SPINS) publication.
metaMetadataThis field gives the identification, revision and issue data of this document.
night_operationsSpinsNightThis field gives the night vision goggles (NVG) procedures, the lights-out areas and the lighting rules.
ordersOrderLinksThis field gives the operation order (OPORD), the air tasking order (ATO) and the airspace control order (ACO) of the publication.
periodPeriodThis field gives the time interval during which the instructions are in effect.
personnel_recoverySpinsRecoveryThis field gives the combat search and rescue (CSAR) and personnel recovery procedures.
recovery_routingSpinsRecoveryRoutingThis field gives the identification, friend or foe (IFF) lines, the routes back and the recovery airfields.
referenceslist of DocumentRefThis list contains the coordination documents for the publication, such as the air tasking order (ATO) or the airspace control order (ACO).
remarksstringThis field gives the remarks about the publication, as free text.
reportslist of ReportRequirementThis list contains the report requirements for aircrews, such as the mission report (MISREP), the in-flight report and the battle damage assessment (BDA) report.
resources_refResourceRefThis field identifies the resource catalogue that resolves the references of this publication.
restrictionsSpinsRestrictionsThis field gives the protected sites and the weather minimums.
rules_of_engagementSpinsRoeThis field gives the rules of engagement (ROE) summary.
schema_version"0.2.0-draft.1"yesThis field gives the version of the openAIX schema that this document agrees with.
scopeenumyesThis field gives the type of the instructions: permanent instructions (standing) or instructions for one mission (mission), as one of the enumerated values.
  • standing
  • mission
tanker_procedureslist of TankerProcedureThis list contains the tanker procedures.
