revisionstringyesThis field gives the revision of the order. The value is the meta.revision field of the order.

PrintExtension

A print extension is the page data that opord-builder puts on each printed page of the order. The namespace is org.opord-builder.print, and the group is for this application only.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
classification_bannerClassificationLevelThis field gives the classification marking on the top and the bottom of each page.
classification_caveatstringThis field gives the dissemination caveat after the classification marking, such as REL TO USA, FVEY, as free text.
copy_numberintegerThis field gives the number of this copy in the distribution. The number should not be more than number_of_copies.
logostringThis field gives the path or the web address of the logo for the cover page.
message_reference_numberstringThis field gives the message reference number that the originator gives to the order, as free text.
number_of_copiesintegerThis field gives the number of copies in the distribution.
page_iconstringThis field gives the path or the web address of the icon for the header of each page.
place_of_issuestringThis field gives the place where the order is issued, as free text.
watermarkstringThis field gives the watermark of each page: short text such as DRAFT, or the path or the web address of an image.

ProtectedSite

A protected site is one site that the operation keeps safe from attack.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this site. Each site in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this site.
kindenumyesThis field gives the type of the site, as one of the enumerated values.
  • cultural
  • religious
  • medical
  • school
  • infrastructure
  • humanitarian
  • other
measureIdentifierThis field identifies the control measure that gives the area of the site.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this site, for display.
positionGeoPointThis field gives the geographic position of the site, as latitude and longitude.
restrictionenumyesThis field gives the restriction on attacks against the site, as one of the enumerated values.
  • no_strike
  • restricted_target

PublicationChange

A change is one change to the base publication.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
openumyesThis field gives the operation of the change, as one of the enumerated values.
  • add
  • replace
  • remove
pathstringyesThis field gives the location of the change, as a JSON Pointer of RFC 6901.
remarksstringThis field gives the remarks about the change, as free text.
valueanyThis field gives the new value at the location. An add or replace change shall have this field. A remove change shall not have this field.

RecoveryAirfield

A recovery airfield is one airfield for aircraft that come back, with its entry point and its procedure.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
airfieldIdentifieryesThis field identifies the airfield that receives the aircraft.
ato_missionslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that use the airfield. The orders field identifies the ATO.
channelslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the radio channels that aircraft use for the recovery.
entry_pointIdentifierThis field identifies the point that is the entry point to the airfield. The point shall have the role control or gate or marshalling.
priorityintegeryesThis field gives the priority of this entry. The value 1 is the highest priority.
procedureIdentifierThis field identifies the procedure of the resource catalogue that gives the steps of the recovery.
routeIdentifierThis field identifies the route of the resource catalogue that aircraft fly to the airfield.

RecoveryAuthentication

A recovery authentication is the authentication values of isolated personnel for one time interval.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
letterstringThis field gives the letter of the day.
numberintegerThis field gives the number of the day, from 0 to 9.
windowWindowyesThis field gives the time interval during which the values are in effect.
wordstringThis field gives the word of the day, as free text.

ReportRequirement

A report requirement is one report that units send, with its time and recipient.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
ato_missionslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that send the report. The orders field identifies the ATO.
channelIdentifierThis field identifies the radio channel that sends the report.
dueDateTimeThis field gives the time of the first report.
from_unitslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the units of the task organization that send the report.
interval_minutesintegerThis field gives the time between two reports, in minutes.
reportIdentifieryesThis field identifies the report of the resource catalogue that this requirement is for.
to_agencyIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that receives the report.
to_unitIdentifierThis field identifies the unit of the task organization that receives the report.
triggerstringThis field gives the event that causes the report, as free text.

RestrictedFrequency

A restricted frequency is one entry of the restricted frequency list.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
agencyIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that controls the frequency.
channelIdentifierThis field identifies the radio channel that the restriction is for.
frequencyFrequencyThis field gives the frequency of the restriction, when no channel identifies it, as a frequency with its unit.
kindenumyesThis field gives the type of the restriction, as one of the enumerated values.
  • taboo
  • protected
  • guarded

ReturnToForce

A return-to-force procedure is the safe passage of friendly aircraft back through friendly air defence.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
agencyIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that controls the safe passage.
altitudeAltitudeBlockThis field gives the vertical limits of the route back, as an altitude block with a floor and a ceiling.
ato_missionslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that use the procedure. The orders field identifies the ATO.
channelslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the radio channels that aircraft use on the route back.
checkpointslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the points that are the identification checkpoints on the route back. Each point shall have the role identification_safety.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this procedure. Each procedure in the publication has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this procedure.
maximum_speedSpeedThis field gives the maximum speed in the safe lanes, as a speed with its unit.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this procedure, for display.
remarksstringThis field gives the remarks about the procedure, as free text.
routeslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the control measures that are minimum-risk routes and corridors back to friendly forces. Each measure shall have the type MRR or SC or TC or AIRCOR or SAAFR or LLTR.
safe_laneslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the control measures that are safe lanes through friendly air defence. Each measure shall have the type SL.
squawkstringThis field gives the Mode 3/A code that aircraft set on the route back, as four octal digits.
windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the procedure is in effect.

RoeRule

A rule of engagement is one rule of the rules of engagement (ROE), with its number and its control measures.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this rule. Each rule in the order has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this rule.
measureslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the control measures that the rule is applicable to.
numberstringThis field gives the number of the rule in the rules of engagement (ROE), such as R-101, as free text.
rulestringyesThis field gives the rule, as free text.
unitslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the units of the task organization that the rule is applicable to.
windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the rule is in effect.

SpinsAirDefense

A special instructions (SPINS) air defence is the air defence procedures for aircrews. It uses the weapons control orders and the air defence warnings of Annex D, Appendix 7, of the operation order (OPORD).

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
commit_criterialist of CommitCriterionThis list contains the commit criteria.
engagement_authoritieslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the command and control agencies that have engagement authority.
identification_matrixlist of IdentificationCriterionThis list contains the rows of the identification matrix.
return_to_forcelist of ReturnToForceThis list contains the return-to-force procedures.
summarystringThis field gives the summary of the air defence procedures, as free text.
warningslist of AirDefenseWarningThis list contains the air defence warnings.
weapons_controllist of WeaponsControlThis list contains the weapons control orders.

SpinsCas

Special instructions (SPINS) close air support (CAS) and laser procedures are the CAS stacks, the laser code plan and the laser restrictions.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
laser_codeslist of LaserCodeAllocationThis list contains the entries of the laser code plan.
lasing_restrictionslist of LasingRestrictionThis list contains the laser restrictions.
remarksstringThis field gives the remarks about the close air support (CAS) and laser procedures, as free text.
stackslist of CasStackThis list contains the close air support (CAS) stacks.

SpinsCommunications

Special instructions (SPINS) communications are the radio nets and the brevity words.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
brevitylist of BrevityTermThis list contains the brevity words of the operation.
netslist of SpinsNetThis list contains the radio nets.
remarksstringThis field gives the remarks about communications, as free text.

SpinsDivertAbort

Special instructions (SPINS) diversion data is the abort conditions and the divert airfields.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
abort_codestringThis field gives the abort code, as free text.
abort_criterialist of AbortCriterionThis list contains the abort conditions.
divert_airfieldslist of DivertAirfieldThis list contains the divert airfields, in order.

SpinsElectromagnetic

A special instructions (SPINS) emission control and electromagnetic attack is the emission control periods and the jamming coordination. It uses the types of Annex C, Appendix 12, of the operation order (OPORD).

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
emission_controllist of EmissionControlPeriodThis list contains the emission control periods, in order.
jamminglist of JammingCoordinationThis list contains the jamming coordination entries.
jamming_authorityIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that gives approval for electromagnetic attack.
remarksstringThis field gives the remarks about the emission control and electromagnetic attack procedures, as free text.

SpinsEmergency

Special instructions (SPINS) emergency procedures are the jettison areas, the routes for aircraft with damage and the lost communication procedures.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
damaged_aircraft_routeslist of DamagedAircraftRouteThis list contains the routes for aircraft with damage.
jettison_areaslist of JettisonAreaThis list contains the jettison areas.
lost_communicationlist of LostCommunicationProcedureThis list contains the lost communication procedures.
remarksstringThis field gives the remarks about the emergency procedures, as free text.

SpinsIdentification

A special instructions (SPINS) identification is the identification, friend or foe (IFF) assignments and code words.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
code_wordslist of CodeWordThis list contains the code words.
ifflist of IffAssignmentThis list contains the identification, friend or foe (IFF) assignments.

SpinsNet

A special instructions (SPINS) net is one radio net for aircrews.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
agencyIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that controls the net.
channelIdentifieryesThis field identifies the radio channel that the net refers to.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this net. Each net in the publication has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this net.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this net, for display.
purposestringThis field gives the purpose of the net, as free text.

SpinsNight

Special instructions (SPINS) night procedures are the night vision goggles (NVG) procedures, the lights-out areas and the lighting rules.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
lightinglist of LightingRuleThis list contains the lighting rules.
lights_out_areaslist of LightsOutAreaThis list contains the lights-out areas.
nvglist of NvgProcedureThis list contains the night vision goggles (NVG) procedures.
remarksstringThis field gives the remarks about the night procedures, as free text.

SpinsRecovery

A special instructions (SPINS) personnel recovery is the combat search and rescue (CSAR) and personnel recovery procedures.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
agencyIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that controls personnel recovery.
authenticationlist of RecoveryAuthenticationThis list contains the authentication values, in order.
channelslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the radio channels that are for isolated personnel and rescue forces.
isoprepstringThis field gives the identifier of the isolated personnel report (ISOPREP) data for recovery forces. The publication does not contain data that identifies a person.
procedureslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the procedures of the resource catalogue that are for isolated personnel and rescue forces.
remarksstringThis field gives the remarks about personnel recovery, as free text.
rescue_forceslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that are rescue forces. The orders field identifies the ATO.
safe_areaslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the control measures that are safe areas for isolated personnel.

SpinsRecoveryRouting

Special instructions (SPINS) recovery routes are the identification, friend or foe (IFF) lines, the routes back and the recovery airfields.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
iff_lineslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the control measures that are lines at which aircraft set the identification, friend or foe (IFF) on or off. Each measure shall have the type IFFON or IFFOFF.
recovery_airfieldslist of RecoveryAirfieldThis list contains the recovery airfields, in order.
remarksstringThis field gives the remarks about the recovery routes, as free text.
return_routeslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the control measures that are routes back to friendly airspace. Each measure shall have the type MRR or SC or TC or AIRCOR or SAAFR or LLTR.
routeslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the routes of the resource catalogue that aircraft fly back to the airfields.

SpinsRestrictions

Special instructions (SPINS) restrictions are the sites that aircrews do not attack and the weather minimums.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
other_protected_siteslist of ProtectedSiteThis list contains the protected sites that the operation order (OPORD) does not give.
protected_siteslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the protected sites of Annex K of the operation order (OPORD) that aircrews do not attack. The orders field identifies the OPORD.
remarksstringThis field gives the remarks about the restrictions, as free text.
weather_minimumslist of WeatherMinimumThis list contains the weather minimums.

SpinsRoe

A special instructions (SPINS) rules of engagement (ROE) summary is the ROE summary for aircrews.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
measureslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the control measures that the rules of engagement (ROE) refer to.
ruleslist of RoeRuleThis list contains the rules of engagement (ROE).
summarystringThis field gives the summary of the rules of engagement (ROE), as free text.

StackBlock

A stack level is one altitude block of a close air support (CAS) stack and the missions that use it.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
altitudeAltitudeBlockyesThis field gives the vertical limits of the level, as an altitude block with a floor and a ceiling.
ato_missionslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that use the level. The orders field identifies the ATO.
useenumThis field gives the purpose of the level, as one of the enumerated values.
  • working
  • holding
  • rotary_wing

TankerProcedure

A tanker procedure is the procedure for one refuelling track or anchor.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
altitudeAltitudeBlockThis field gives the vertical limits of the refuelling, as an altitude block with a floor and a ceiling.
ato_missionslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that are tanker missions on the track. The orders field identifies the ATO.
channelslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the radio channels that are for the tanker and receivers.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this procedure. Each procedure in the publication has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this procedure.
procedureIdentifierThis field identifies the procedure of the resource catalogue that gives the rendezvous steps.
remarksstringThis field gives the remarks about the procedure, as free text.
tacanTACANThis field gives the channel of the tanker for Tactical Air Navigation (TACAN).
trackIdentifieryesThis field identifies the orbit that is the refuelling track or anchor. The measure shall be an orbit.

WeaponsControl

A weapons control order is one weapons control status for an area and a time interval.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
measureIdentifierThis field identifies the control measure that gives the area of the weapons control status.
statusenumyesThis field gives the weapons control status, as one of the enumerated values.
  • free
  • tight
  • hold
windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the weapons control status is in effect.

WeatherMinimum

A weather minimum is the lowest ceiling and visibility for one type of tasking or one phase of flight.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
airfieldIdentifierThis field identifies the airfield that the minimum is applicable to.
ato_missionslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the missions of the air tasking order (ATO) that the minimum is applicable to. The orders field identifies the ATO.
ceilingLengthThis field gives the lowest height of the cloud base above the ground, as a length with its unit.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this minimum. Each minimum in the publication has a different identifier. Other parts of the order use it to refer to this minimum.
phaseenumThis field gives the phase of flight that the minimum is applicable to, as one of the enumerated values.
  • ground
  • departure
  • en_route
  • air_refueling
  • target_area
  • recovery
  • landing
taskingslist of enumThis list contains the types of typed tasking that the minimum is applicable to.
  • preplanned_attack
  • on_call_cas
  • cap
  • escort
  • refueling
  • airborne_control
  • reconnaissance
  • electromagnetic
  • transport
  • personnel_recovery
  • training
  • custom
  • counterair
  • counterland_control
visibilityLengthThis field gives the lowest flight visibility, as a length with its unit.

ATO

urn:openaix:schema:ato:0.2.0-draft.1

ato

An air tasking order (ATO) is an order that tasks missions and gives their flights and packages. It also gives the control of the missions and the resources that help them.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
$schemastring (uri)This field identifies the schema that validates this document.
acoDocumentRefThis field identifies the airspace control order (ACO) that this air tasking order (ATO) coordinates with. The reference identifies a document. It does not activate airspace.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
general_instructionslist of stringThis list contains the instructions that are applicable to all missions in the order.
kind"ato"yesThe value identifies this record as an air tasking order (ATO).
metaMetadataThis field gives the identification, revision and issue data of this air tasking order (ATO).
missionslist of MissionyesThis list contains the missions that the order tasks. Each mission has a mission number, one typed tasking and the flights that the order gives to it.
packageslist of PackageThis list contains the packages that contain missions that fly together for one objective.
periodPeriodyesThis field gives the time interval during which the order tasks missions.
resourcesResourceDataThis field contains a resource catalogue in the order. The catalogue resolves the references of the order. The order shall have resources or resources_ref, but not the two fields.
resources_refResourceRefThis field identifies the external resource catalogue that resolves the references of the order. More than one document can use the same catalogue. The reference identifies the catalogue and gives its revision. The order shall have resources or resources_ref, but not the two fields.
schema_version"0.2.0-draft.1"This field gives the version of the openAIX schema that this air tasking order (ATO) agrees with.
spinsPinnedRefThis field identifies the special instructions (SPINS) publication that is applicable to this order. The reference identifies the publication and one revision of it.

Activity

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
altitudeAltitudeThis field gives the altitude at which the flight can do this operation, as an altitude with its unit and reference.
areaAreaSelection | AirspaceSelectionThis field identifies the planning area or control measure in which the flight does this operation.
descriptionstringThis field gives the data about this operation and its local conditions, as free text.
idstringyesThis field identifies this flight operation. Other records and orders use it to refer to this flight operation.
instructionslist of stringThis list contains the instructions for this flight operation.
kindenumyesThis field gives the type of flight operation, as one of the enumerated values.
  • transit This value identifies a flight from one point to a different point.
  • hold The flight holds at a point or in an area.
  • station This value identifies time on station in an area.
  • refuel This value identifies air-to-air refuelling from a flight that helps.
  • task This value identifies the execution of the tasking of the mission.
  • recovery The flight goes back to an airfield for the landing.
  • other This value identifies an operation that the other values do not include.
support_flightstringThis field identifies the flight that helps with this operation, such as the tanker for a refuelling operation.
windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the flight does this operation.

AfterTime

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
atstring (date-time) | OffsetyesThis field gives the time before which the event does not occur. The value is a date and time, or an offset in minutes from the start of the order period.
kind"not_before"yesThe value identifies this record as a time condition not before a time.

AgencyControl

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
agencystringyesThis field identifies the command and control agency that controls the mission.
check_instringThis field identifies the procedure that the flights follow when they first contact the agency.
handoverslist of stringThis list identifies the command and control agencies that get the control of the mission after the first agency. The list is in the sequence of the handovers.
kind"agency"yesThe value identifies this record as control by an agency.

AirAssaultBrief

An air assault brief is the data that air assault aircrews get before the mission. FM 3-99 (2015) Chapters 12 and 13 give the air movement table and the lifts, serials and chalks.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
air_movement_tablelist of AirMovementLineThis list contains the lines of the air movement table, in order.
corridorslist of ControlMeasureSelectionThis list identifies the air corridors and transit routes that are for the serials.
escort_missionslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the escort and attack missions that defend the serials.
h_hourDateTimeThis field gives the time at which the first serial is on the landing zone (LZ).
landing_zoneslist of ControlMeasureSelectionyesThis list identifies the landing zones (LZs) that the troops go out of the aircraft at.
pickup_zoneslist of ControlMeasureSelectionyesThis list identifies the pickup zones (PZs) that the troops go into the aircraft at.
remarksstringThis field gives the notes for the aircrews that are not in the other fields of this brief, as free text.
routeslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the routes that the serials fly between the pickup zones (PZs) and the landing zones (LZs).

AirMovementLine

An air movement line is one line of the air movement table, for one serial of one lift. FM 3-99 (2015) paragraph 12-37 gives the data of the line.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
chalkslist of integerThis list contains the chalk numbers of the aircraft in the serial.
flightIdentifieryesThis field identifies the flight that flies the serial.
landing_formationenumThis field gives the formation of the serial when it lands, as one of the enumerated values.
  • trail
  • staggered_trail
  • echelon
  • vee
  • diamond
  • heavy
landing_headingBearingThis field gives the heading of the serial when it lands, as a bearing with its unit and reference.
landing_timeDateTimeThis field gives the time at which the serial is on the landing zone (LZ).
landing_zoneControlMeasureSelectionyesThis field identifies the landing zone (LZ) that is the end of the flight of the serial.
liftintegeryesThis field gives the number of the lift of the line.
lifted_unitstringThis field gives the name of the unit in the serial, as free text.
lineintegeryesThis field gives the number of the line in the air movement table.
loadManifestThis field gives the personnel and the cargo of the serial.
load_timeDateTimeThis field gives the time at which the troops go into the aircraft at the pickup zone (PZ).
pickup_zoneControlMeasureSelectionyesThis field identifies the pickup zone (PZ) that the serial loads at.
release_pointControlMeasureSelectionThis field identifies the release point that the serial flies through before the landing zone (LZ).
release_point_timeDateTimeThis field gives the time at which the serial is at the release point.
remarksstringThis field gives the notes about this serial, such as a change of time, as free text.
routeIdentifierThis field identifies the route that is for the serial.
serialintegeryesThis field gives the number of the serial in the lift.
start_pointControlMeasureSelectionThis field identifies the start point that the serial flies through after the pickup zone (PZ).
start_point_timeDateTimeThis field gives the time at which the serial is at the start point.
takeoff_timeDateTimeThis field gives the time of of the departure of the serial from the pickup zone (PZ).

AirToAirBrief

An air-to-air brief is the data for a combat air patrol (CAP), a fighter sweep, an air intercept or an escort.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
bullseyeControlMeasureSelectionThis field identifies the bullseye that is the reference point of the controller and the fighters. The point shall have the role bullseye.
commit_criterialist of CommitCriterionThis list contains the commit criteria that start an engagement of an air track.
controllerControllerContactThis field gives the agency that controls the fighters, such as an Airborne Warning and Control System (AWACS), with its radio channels.
identification_procedureIdentifierThis field identifies the procedure that gives the identification matrix and the rules of engagement (ROE) for air tracks.
protected_measureslist of ControlMeasureSelectionThis list identifies the orbits and areas that the fighters defend, such as tanker and Airborne Warning and Control System (AWACS) orbits.
protected_missionslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the missions that the fighters defend.
remarksstringThis field gives the notes for the aircrews that are not in the other fields of this brief, as free text.
roe_referenceDocumentRefThis field identifies the part of the special instructions (SPINS) or of a different document that gives the rules of engagement (ROE).
threat_emitterslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the surface-to-air emitters that the fighters avoid.

AirborneControl

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
abort_criterialist of stringThis list contains the conditions in which the flights stop the airborne control task.
altitudeAltitudeBlockThis field gives the vertical limits of this airborne control task, as an altitude block with a floor and a ceiling.
areaAreaSelection | AirspaceSelectionyesThis field identifies the planning area or control measure in which the airborne control station is.
briefAirborneControlBriefThis field gives the data of the mission brief for this airborne control task. The brief refers to the records of the resource catalogue and does not copy them.
control_responsibilitieslist of stringThis list contains the control and surveillance tasks of the airborne control mission.
datalinkIdentificationThis field gives the data link and identification values of the airborne control task.
handoverstringThis field gives the instructions for the handover of the airborne control station, as free text.
kind"airborne_control"yesThe value identifies this record as an airborne control tasking.
objectivestringThis field gives the result that the airborne control task is for, as free text.
report_refslist of stringThis list identifies the report definitions of the reports that the airborne control task sends. Each identifier refers to the reports map of the resource catalogue.
station_windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the airborne control aircraft are on station.
success_criteriastringThis field gives the conditions that show a satisfactory result of the airborne control task, as free text.
supported_missionslist of stringThis list identifies the missions that the airborne control task helps.

AirborneControlBrief

An airborne control brief is the data that an airborne control aircrew gets before the mission.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
bullseyeControlMeasureSelectionThis field identifies the bullseye that is the reference point of the controllers. The point shall have the role bullseye.
controlled_channelslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the radio channels that the control aircraft uses to control flights.
handover_pointslist of ControlMeasureSelectionThis list identifies the points that flights change controller at. Each point shall have the role handover or control.
orbitControlMeasureSelectionThis field identifies the orbit or airborne early warning area that is the station of the control aircraft.
remarksstringThis field gives the notes for the aircrews that are not in the other fields of this brief, as free text.
sectorslist of ControlSectorThis list contains the control sectors of the control aircraft.

AirborneLaunch

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
altitudeAltitudeyesThis field gives the altitude that the order gives for the airborne launch, as an altitude with its unit and reference.
atstring (date-time) | OffsetThis field gives the time at which the flight starts in the air. The value is a date and time, or an offset in minutes from the start of the order period.
kind"airborne"yesThe value identifies this record as an airborne start.
positionGeoPointyesThis field gives the geographic position of the airborne launch, as latitude and longitude.
speedSpeedThis field gives the speed of the flight at the start in the air, as a speed with its unit.

AircraftOverride

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
board_numberstringThis field gives the board number of this aircraft, also called the modex, painted on the airframe, as free text.
crewlist of CrewMemberThis list contains the crew members of this aircraft.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
fuelFuelPlanThis field gives the fuel plan of this aircraft, which replaces the fuel plan of the flight.
identificationIdentificationThis field gives the identification values of this aircraft, which replace the values of the flight.
laser_codeLaserCodeThis field gives the laser code of this aircraft, as a laser code with its unit.
memberintegeryesThis field gives the position number of this aircraft in the flight, from 1.
sclstringThis field identifies the standard conventional load (SCL) that this aircraft has, which replaces the primary SCL of the flight.

AirdropBrief

An airdrop brief is the data for an airdrop mission. FM 3-99 (2015) Chapter 5 and FM 3-21.38 (2006) Chapter 6 give these data.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
authentication_procedureIdentifierThis field identifies the procedure that gives the authentication between the aircrew and the drop zone (DZ) support team.
clear_to_drop_signalenumThis field gives the signal that gives the clearance to release the load, as one of the enumerated values.
  • radio
  • smoke
  • code_letter
  • light
code_letterstringThis field gives the code letter on the drop zone (DZ), as one letter from A to Z.
drop_airspeedSpeedThis field gives the airspeed at which the aircraft release the load, with its unit.
drop_altitudeAltitudeThis field gives the altitude at which the aircraft release the load, as an altitude with its unit and reference.
drop_windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the aircraft release the load.
drop_zoneControlMeasureSelectionyesThis field identifies the drop zone (DZ) that receives the airdrop.
drop_zone_controllerControllerContactThis field gives the agency that controls the drop zone (DZ), with its radio channels.
load_typeenumThis field gives the type of the load, as one of the enumerated values.
  • personnel This value identifies a drop of troops or other personnel with parachutes.
  • heavy_equipment This value identifies a heavy drop of vehicles or equipment on platforms.
  • container_delivery_system This value identifies an airdrop of supplies in containers. The containers go out of the rear of the aircraft in sequence, because of their weight.
  • door_bundle This value identifies a small load that the aircrew pushes out of a door at the side of the aircraft.
  • precision_airdrop This value identifies an airdrop in which a guidance system moves the parachute of each load to the point of impact.
markingslist of enumThis list contains the markings of the drop zone (DZ) that the aircrew looks for.
  • raised_angle_marker
  • code_letter
  • panels
  • lights
  • smoke
parachute_techniqueenumThis field gives the parachute method of the personnel drop, as one of the enumerated values.
  • static_line This value identifies a parachute drop at low altitude. A line in the aircraft opens each parachute when the person goes out of the aircraft.
  • halo This value identifies a high-altitude low-opening (HALO) personnel drop. The personnel go out of the aircraft at high altitude and open their parachutes at low altitude.
  • haho This value identifies a high-altitude high-opening (HAHO) personnel drop. The personnel open their parachutes at high altitude a short time after they go out of the aircraft. Then they fly a long distance to the drop zone (DZ) with their parachutes.
point_of_impactControlMeasureSelectionThis field identifies the point that is the point of impact on the drop zone (DZ).
release_methodenumThis field gives the method that sets the release point, as one of the enumerated values.
  • carp This value identifies a computed air release point (CARP) that the aircrew calculates.
  • harp This value identifies a high-altitude release point (HARP) for a high-altitude low-opening (HALO) or high-altitude high-opening (HAHO) personnel drop.
  • gmrs This value identifies a ground-marked release system (GMRS), in which markings on the ground show the release point.
  • virs This value identifies a verbally initiated release system (VIRS), in which the drop zone (DZ) support team tells the aircrew when to release.
release_pointControlMeasureSelectionThis field identifies the point that is the release point in the plan.
remarksstringThis field gives the notes for the aircrews that are not in the other fields of this brief, as free text.
run_in_headingBearingThis field gives the heading of the aircraft on the run-in to the drop zone (DZ), as a bearing with its unit and reference.

AirspaceSelection

Type: ControlMeasureSelection

AlertLaunch

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
availabilityWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the alert launch is available.
departurestringyesThis field identifies the airfield, carrier or forward arming and refuelling point (FARP) that keeps the alert aircraft.
kind"alert"yesThe value identifies this record as an alert launch.
readiness_minutesnumberThis field gives the time from the launch order until the aircraft are in the air, in minutes.
release_authoritystringThis field identifies the command and control agency that gives the order to launch the alert aircraft.

Altitude

An altitude is a vertical position with its unit and its reference: mean sea level (MSL), above ground level (AGL) or flight level (FL).

Type: Altitude

AltitudeBlock

An altitude block is a vertical band between a floor and a ceiling. The floor can be the surface, and the ceiling can have no limit.

Type: AltitudeBlock

AreaSelection

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
areastringyesThis field identifies the planning area that this selection contains.

AreaTargetSelection

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
kind"area"yesThe value identifies this record as a selected area target.
targetstringyesThis field identifies the area target that this selection contains.

AtTime

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
atstring (date-time) | OffsetyesThis field gives the time at which the event occurs. The value is a date and time, or an offset in minutes from the start of the order period.
kind"at"yesThe value identifies this record as a time condition at a time.
tolerance_secondsnumberThis field gives the maximum time interval between the event and the time in at, in seconds. The limit is applicable before and after that time.

AttackAssignment

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
activation_conditionstringThis field gives the condition in which this attack assignment starts, as free text.
assigned_tolist of FlightSelectionThis list contains the flights and aircraft that attack the target.
desired_effectenumThis field gives the effect on the target that the attack assignment gives, as one of the enumerated values. The values are openAIX values with no doctrinal source.
  • destroy The attack destroys the target. This is an openAIX value with no doctrinal source.
  • neutralize The attack neutralizes the target. This is an openAIX value with no doctrinal source.
  • suppress The attack suppresses the target. This is an openAIX value with no doctrinal source.
  • disrupt The attack disrupts the target. This is an openAIX value with no doctrinal source.
  • degrade The attack degrades the target. This is an openAIX value with no doctrinal source.
  • deny After the attack, the enemy cannot use the target. This is an openAIX value with no doctrinal source.
  • divert The attack diverts the target or its resources. This is an openAIX value with no doctrinal source.
idstringyesThis field identifies this attack assignment. Other records and orders use it to refer to this attack assignment.
instructionslist of stringThis list contains the instructions for this attack assignment.
priorityintegerThis field gives the priority of this attack assignment in the tasking. Priority 1 is the highest.
required_storeslist of stringThis list identifies the stores that are necessary for the attack on the target.
restrictionslist of stringThis list contains the limits and conditions that are applicable to this attack assignment.
roleenumThis field gives the role of this attack assignment: primary or alternate, as one of the enumerated values.
  • primary The selected aircraft do this assignment first.
  • alternate The selected aircraft do this assignment when the primary assignment is not possible.
success_criteriastringThis field gives the conditions that show a satisfactory result of the attack assignment, as free text.
targetFixedSelection | MobileSelection | AreaTargetSelectionyesThis field gives the target of this attack assignment. The target is a fixed target with aimpoint identifiers, a mobile target or an area target.
target_list_entryTargetListEntryThis field gives the joint integrated prioritized target list (JIPTL) or time-sensitive target (TST) entry of the target of this attack assignment.
timingAtTime | InWindow | BeforeTime | AfterTime | OnOrderThis field gives the time condition for the attack. The condition is at a time, in a window, not before a time, not after a time, or on order.
weaponeeringlist of WeaponLoadThis list contains the weapon loads of the flights for this attack assignment.

AttackBrief

An attack brief is the data that aircrews get before a preplanned attack. The role of the tasking gives the type of attack. The attack assignments of the tasking give the targets, the effects, the times on target and the weapons.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
bdaBDARequirementThis field gives the battle damage assessment (BDA) that the aircrews collect after the attack.
casCASBriefThis field gives the close air support (CAS) data. The field is applicable to the scheduled_cas role.
egress_pointslist of ControlMeasureSelectionThis list identifies the egress points or gates that the flights fly through after the attack. Each point shall have the role egress or gate.
egress_routeIdentifierThis field identifies the route that the flights use after the attack.
ingress_routeIdentifierThis field identifies the route that the flights use to fly to the target area.
initial_pointslist of ControlMeasureSelectionThis list identifies the initial points that start the attack runs. Each point shall have the role initial.
remarksstringThis field gives the notes for the aircrews that are not in the other fields of this brief, as free text.
restricted_areaslist of ControlMeasureSelectionThis list identifies the no-fire areas, restrictive fire areas or no-fly zones that are applicable to the attack. Each no-strike site near a target has a no-fire area around it.
seadSEADBriefThis field gives the suppression of enemy air defences (SEAD) data. The field is applicable to SEAD and destruction of enemy air defences (DEAD) roles.
threat_emitterslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the emitters that can engage the flights on the route or at the target.

BDARequirement

A battle damage assessment (BDA) requirement is the BDA that the aircrew collects after the attack.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
deadlineDateTimeThis field gives the time before which the aircrew sends the battle damage assessment (BDA).
methodenumyesThis field gives the method that the aircrew uses to collect the battle damage assessment (BDA), as one of the enumerated values.
  • weapon_system_video
  • visual
  • imagery
  • sensor_report
recipientIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that receives the battle damage assessment (BDA).
reportIdentifierThis field identifies the report definition that the aircrew uses to send the battle damage assessment (BDA).

BeforeTime

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
atstring (date-time) | OffsetyesThis field gives the time after which the event does not occur. The value is a date and time, or an offset in minutes from the start of the order period.
kind"not_after"yesThe value identifies this record as a time condition not after a time.

CASBrief

CargoItem

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
handlingstringThis field gives the handling instructions for this cargo item, as free text.

quantityintegeryesThis field gives the number of units of this cargo item.

CollectionRequirement

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
areaAreaSelection | AirspaceSelectionyesThis field identifies the planning area or control measure in which the flight collects the information.
collection_windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the flight collects the information.
eeislist of objectThis list contains the essential elements of information (EEIs) of this collection.
idstringyesThis field identifies this collection entry. Other records and orders use it to refer to this collection entry.
information_requiredstringyesThis field gives the information that the flight gets, as free text.
latest_useful_timestring (date-time) | OffsetThis field gives the time after which the information has no value. The value is a date and time, or an offset in minutes from the start of the order period.
productenumThis field gives the output that the flight sends, as one of the enumerated values.
  • full_motion_video
  • still_imagery
  • coordinates
  • voice_report
  • written_report
  • signals_report
recipientstringThis field identifies the command and control agency that receives the output.
reportingReportingPlanThis field gives the method and the time of the reports for this collection.
sensorenumThis field gives the type of sensor that the flight uses for the collection, as one of the enumerated values.
  • electro_optical
  • infrared
  • electro_optical_infrared
  • radar
  • synthetic_aperture_radar
  • signals
  • visual
  • other
targetstringThis field identifies the target that the collection is about.

CommitCriterion

A commit criterion is a condition in which the fighters start an engagement of an air track. A commit criterion shall give a range, a boundary or a procedure.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
boundaryControlMeasureSelectionThis field identifies the control measure that is the boundary of this commit criterion.
procedureIdentifierThis field identifies the procedure that gives the full commit criteria.
rangeLengthThis field gives the range from the fighters or from their defended asset at which they start the engagement, as a length with its unit.
threatIdentifierThis field identifies the threat that this commit criterion is for.

Configuration

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
alternativeslist of SCLAlternativeThis list contains the standard conventional loads (SCLs) that the flight can use as alternatives, and the conditions in which it uses them.
member_overrideslist of AircraftOverrideThis list contains the values for one aircraft that are different from the values of the flight.
primary_sclstringyesThis field identifies the standard conventional load (SCL) that all aircraft of the flight have, unless an aircraft entry gives a different load.
secondary_purposestringThis field gives the function of the standard conventional load (SCL) in secondary_scl, as free text.
secondary_sclstringThis field identifies the standard conventional load (SCL) that the flight has for a second function.

Contingency

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
actionstringyesThis field gives the step that the flight does when the condition occurs, as free text.
alternate_routestringThis field identifies the route that the flight uses for this contingency.
conditionstringyesThis field gives the condition that starts this contingency, as free text.
decision_authorityIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that makes the decision for this contingency.
divertstringThis field identifies the airfield, carrier or forward arming and refuelling point (FARP) that the flight goes to for this contingency.

ControlSector

A control sector is a part of the airspace that one controller of the control aircraft controls.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
altitudeAltitudeBlockThis field gives the vertical limits of the control sector, as an altitude block with a floor and a ceiling.
areaAreaSelection | AirspaceSelectionThis field identifies the planning area or control measure that is the sector.
channelIdentifierThis field identifies the radio channel that is for the controller of the sector.
flightslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the flights that the controller of the sector controls.
missionslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the missions that the controller of the sector controls.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this control sector, for display.

ControllerContact

An agency channel is an agency for the aircrew, with its radio channels.

Type: ControllerContact

CounterAir

A counterair task is a fighter sweep or an air intercept. A fighter sweep shall have an operating area. An air intercept shall identify a target, or the area where the fighters contact the target. Combat air patrol (CAP) is a different type of tasking.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
abort_criterialist of stringThis list contains the conditions in which the fighters stop the task.
altitudeAltitudeBlockThis field gives the vertical limits of the counterair task, as an altitude block with a floor and a ceiling.
areaAreaSelection | AirspaceSelectionThis field identifies the area or airspace that contains the fighter sweep or the air intercept.
briefAirToAirBriefThis field gives the data of the mission brief for this counterair task. The brief refers to the records of the resource catalogue and does not copy them.
engagement_instructionsstringThis field identifies the procedure that gives the commit criteria and the engagement conditions.
kind"counterair"yesThe value identifies this record as a counterair tasking.
mission_typeenumyesThis field gives the type of counterair task: fighter_sweep or interception, as one of the enumerated values.
  • fighter_sweep This value identifies an offensive counterair mission. Fighters go into a specified area to find and destroy enemy aircraft or a target of opportunity.
  • interception This value identifies an air intercept. Fighters contact an air track to identify it. The track is a hostile track, a possibly hostile track or an unknown track. An air intercept does not authorize an engagement.
objectivestringThis field gives the result that the counterair task is for, as free text.
operating_windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the fighter sweep or the air intercept occurs, as the plan gives it.
report_refslist of stringThis list identifies the reports that the task sends.
success_criteriastringThis field gives the conditions that show a satisfactory result of the task, as free text.
targetMobileSelectionThis field identifies the mobile target that is the aircraft or the formation for the air intercept. The target is not always an enemy. Its position and simulator bindings stay on the target record.

CounterlandControl

A counterland control task is a strike coordination and reconnaissance (SCAR) or airborne forward air controller (FAC(A)) task in a specified area. In a SCAR mission, the aircraft find targets and coordinate the attacks of other flights on them. In a FAC(A) mission, the aircraft give terminal attack control to close air support (CAS) aircraft. SCAR aircraft do not have the authority of terminal attack control.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
abort_criterialist of stringThis list contains the conditions in which the flights stop the counterland control task.
altitudeAltitudeBlockThis field gives the vertical limits of the counterland control task, as an altitude block with a floor and a ceiling.
areaAreaSelection | AirspaceSelectionyesThis field identifies the planning area or control measure in which the aircraft find targets and control the attacks.
briefSCARBrief | FACABriefThis field gives the data of the mission brief for this counterland control task. The brief refers to the records of the resource catalogue and does not copy them.
kind"counterland_control"yesThe value identifies this record as a counterland control tasking.
mission_typeenumyesThis field gives the type of counterland control task: scar or fac_a, as one of the enumerated values.
  • scar This value identifies strike coordination and reconnaissance (SCAR). Aircraft find targets in a specified area and coordinate the attacks of other flights on them.
  • fac_a This value identifies an airborne forward air controller (FAC(A)) mission. A FAC(A) gives terminal attack control to close air support (CAS) aircraft from the air.
objectivestringThis field gives the result that the counterland control task is for, as free text.
operating_windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the aircraft are on station in the area.
report_refslist of stringThis list identifies the report definitions of the reports that the counterland control task sends. Each identifier refers to the reports map of the resource catalogue.
success_criteriastringThis field gives the conditions that show a satisfactory result of the counterland control task, as free text.

CrewMember

A crew member is one person in the crew of an aircraft.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
namestringyesThis field gives the name of the crew member, as a name or a callsign, as free text.
roleenumyesThis field gives the role of the crew member in the aircraft, as one of the enumerated values.
  • pilot This value identifies the crew member who has command and flies the aircraft.
  • copilot This value identifies the second pilot, who helps the pilot in the front or the side seat.
  • weapon_systems_officer This value identifies a crew member who runs the weapons and the sensors from a rear seat.
  • radar_intercept_officer This value identifies a crew member who runs the radar and the intercept from a rear seat.
  • gunner This value identifies the crew member who aims and fires the guns and the missiles of a helicopter.
  • other This value identifies a crew member that the other values do not include.

CustomBrief

A custom brief is a set of values with names for a custom task, with the namespace of the application that gives the values.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
dataobjectyesThis field contains the data of the brief, as values with names.
namespacestringyesThis field gives the namespace of the application or standard that gives the data, such as org.example.task, as free text.
remarksstringThis field gives the notes for the aircrews that are not in the other fields of this brief, as free text.
schemastring (uri)This field identifies the schema that validates the data.

CustomTask

FieldTypeRequiredDescription

extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
kind"custom"yesThe value identifies this record as a tasking for a custom task.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this custom task, for display.
objectivestringThis field gives the result that the custom task is for, as free text.
operating_windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the custom task occurs.
report_refslist of stringThis list identifies the report definitions of the reports that the custom task sends. Each identifier refers to the reports map of the resource catalogue.
required_capabilitieslist of stringThis list contains the functions that are necessary for the flights of the custom task.
success_criteriastringThis field gives the conditions that show a satisfactory result of the custom task, as free text.

DocumentRef

A document reference is a document that a record refers to. Consumers do not get the document automatically through a network.

Type: DocumentRef

ElectromagneticBrief

FieldTypeRequiredDescription

briefElectromagneticBriefThis field gives the data of the mission brief for this electromagnetic task. The brief refers to the records of the resource catalogue and does not copy them.
coordination_procedurestringThis field identifies the procedure that coordinates the electromagnetic task.
equipment_requirementslist of stringThis list contains the equipment that is necessary for the electromagnetic task.

restrictionslist of stringThis list contains the limits and conditions that are applicable to this electromagnetic task.

EmitterTarget

An emitter target is an emitter that is a target of the mission, with its priority.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription

Escort

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
abort_criterialist of stringThis list contains the conditions in which the flights stop the escort.
briefAirToAirBriefThis field gives the data of the mission brief for this escort. The brief refers to the records of the resource catalogue and does not copy them.
kind"escort"yesThe value identifies this record as an escort tasking.
objectivestringThis field gives the result that the escort is for, as free text.
protection_windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the escort gives protection to the missions.
release_conditionstringThis field gives the condition at which the escort stops the protection of the missions, as free text.
rendezvousstringThis field identifies the control point that is the rendezvous point of the escort and the missions that it gives protection to.
rendezvous_timeAtTime | InWindow | BeforeTime | AfterTime | OnOrderThis field gives the time condition for the rendezvous of the escort. The condition is at a time, in a window, not before a time, not after a time, or on order.

separation_instructionsstringThis field gives the position of the escort in relation to the missions that it gives protection to, as free text.
success_criteriastringThis field gives the conditions that show a satisfactory result of the escort, as free text.
supported_missionslist of stringyesThis list identifies the missions that the escort helps.

FACABrief

A forward air controller brief is the data that the aircraft get before an airborne forward air controller (FAC(A)) mission.

friendly_lineslist of ControlMeasureSelectionThis list identifies the lines and boundaries that show the positions of the friendly ground forces.
ground_scheme_summarystringThis field gives the plan of the friendly ground forces, in short form, as free text.
holdinglist of ControlMeasureSelectionThis list identifies the orbits, points or zones that the aircraft use to hold before they get a task.

laser_codeslist of LaserCodeThis list contains the laser codes for the controller and the aircraft in this airborne forward air controller (FAC(A)) mission.
markslist of TargetMarkThis list contains the types of target mark that the controller can supply. JP 3-09.3 (2014) gives these marks.
remarksstringThis field gives the notes for the aircrews that are not in the other fields of this brief, as free text.
supported_unitstringThis field gives the name of the ground unit that the airborne forward air controller (FAC(A)) supports, as free text.
terminal_controllist of enumThis list contains the types of terminal attack control that the airborne forward air controller (FAC(A)) can give.

Flight

aircraft_typeIdentifieryesThis field identifies the aircraft type that the aircraft of this flight have.

fuelFuelPlanThis field gives the fuel plan of this flight.

FuelPlan

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
bingoMassThis field gives the bingo fuel, which is the fuel quantity at which the flight starts to go back to base.
burn_rateFuelRateThis field gives the fuel burn rate, as a fuel quantity for each hour with its unit.
initialMass | InternalFuelyesThis field gives the fuel at the start of the mission. The value is a quantity with its unit, or a percentage of full fuel in the aircraft and in the external tanks.

FuelRate

A fuel rate is a fuel quantity for each hour, with its unit.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
unitenumyesThis field gives the unit of the fuel rate: kilograms or pounds for each hour, as one of the enumerated values.
  • kg/h The fuel quantity is in kilograms for each hour.
  • lb/h The fuel quantity is in pounds for each hour. One pound is 0.45359237 kilograms.
valuenumberyesThis field gives the fuel quantity for each hour, in the unit that unit gives.

A geographic point is a position in WGS 84 decimal degrees. An adapter is necessary for the Cartesian coordinates of a simulator.

Type: GeoPoint

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
datalink_networkstringThis field gives the name of the data link network of this flight, as free text.

datalink_typestringThis field gives the type of data link, such as Link 16, as free text.
instructionslist of stringThis list contains the instructions for identification.
link16Link16This field gives the Link 16 data set of this flight or aircraft.

mode_2stringThis field gives the identification, friend or foe (IFF) mode 2 code, as four digits from 0 to 7.
mode_3stringThis field gives the identification, friend or foe (IFF) mode 3 code, as four digits from 0 to 7.
mode_4enumThis field gives the condition of identification, friend or foe (IFF) mode 4, as one of the enumerated values.
  • on The identification, friend or foe (IFF) transponder operates in Mode 4.
  • off The identification, friend or foe (IFF) transponder does not operate in Mode 4.
  • as_directed The flight sets the mode as the instructions of the mission tell it.
mode_5enumThis field gives the condition of identification, friend or foe (IFF) mode 5, as one of the enumerated values.
  • on The identification, friend or foe (IFF) transponder operates in Mode 5.
  • off The identification, friend or foe (IFF) transponder does not operate in Mode 5.
  • as_directed The flight sets the mode as the instructions of the mission tell it.
tacanTACANThis field gives the channel, band and identifier of the Tactical Air Navigation (TACAN) of this flight, for air-to-air operation.

windowWindowyesThis field gives the time interval during which the event occurs.

Link16
