FieldTypeRequiredDescription
donorslist of LinkStationThis list contains the station numbers of the donors, which are the stations that send the track data to the aircraft.
fighter_channelintegerThis field gives the Multifunction Information Distribution System (MIDS) channel of the fighter net, from 1 to 127.
mission_channelintegerThis field gives the Multifunction Information Distribution System (MIDS) channel of the mission net, from 1 to 127.
special_channelintegerThis field gives the Multifunction Information Distribution System (MIDS) channel of the special net, from 1 to 127.
stnLinkStationThis field gives the Link 16 station number of the aircraft, as five octal digits.
teamlist of LinkStationThis list contains the station numbers of the team members of the aircraft.

Manifest

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
cargolist of CargoItemThis list contains the cargo items of the transport mission.
passengersintegerThis field gives the number of persons on the aircraft of the transport mission.
personnel_notesstringThis field gives the notes about the personnel on the aircraft of the transport mission, as free text.

Mass

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
unitenumyesThis field gives the unit of the fuel quantity, as one of the enumerated values.
  • kg The mass is in kilograms.
  • lb The mass is in pounds. One pound is 0.45359237 kilograms.
valuenumberyesThis field gives the fuel quantity as a number, in the unit that unit gives.

Metadata

Type: Metadata

Mission

A mission is a task that the order gives, with a mission number, one typed tasking and the flights for it. The consumer keeps the condition of the allocation and of the execution.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
constraintslist of stringThis list contains the limits that are applicable to this mission.
contingencieslist of ContingencyThis list contains the steps in the plan for conditions that change the plan of this mission.
controlAgencyControl | SelfControlThis field gives the control of this mission: a command and control agency, or one of the flights of the mission.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
flightslist of FlightyesThis list contains the flights that the order gives to the mission. When the list is empty, the tasking has no allocation.
idstringyesThis field identifies this mission. Other records and orders use it to refer to this mission.
mission_numberstringyesThis field identifies this mission. Each mission in the order has a different identifier. Units use the mission number to refer to the mission on kneeboards and by voice.
packagestringThis field identifies the package that contains this mission.
priorityintegerThis field gives the priority of this mission in the order. Priority 1 is the highest.
request_refslist of DocumentRefThis list contains the references to the requests that this mission is for.
supportlist of SupportLinkThis list contains the flights that help this mission, with their roles.
taskingPreplannedAttack | OnCallCAS | Patrol | Escort | Refueling | AirborneControl | Reconnaissance | ElectromagneticTask | Transport | PersonnelRecovery | Training | CustomTask | CounterAir | CounterlandControlyesThis field gives the one typed tasking of this mission.
tasking_relationshipenumThis field gives the relation between the order and this mission, as one of the enumerated values.
  • assigned The order tasks the mission.
  • coordination_only The order shows the mission only for coordination, and does not task it.
threat_refslist of stringThis list identifies the possible threats that are applicable to this mission.

MobileSelection

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
kind"mobile"yesThe value identifies this record as a selected mobile target.
targetstringyesThis field identifies the mobile target that this selection contains.

Offset

An offset is a number of minutes from the start of the period of the air tasking order (ATO) that contains it. The value can be less than zero.

Type: Offset

OnCallCAS

An on-call close air support (CAS) tasking is a tasking for the on-call type of preplanned close air support, or for immediate close air support. JP 3-09.3 (2014) paragraph 27 gives these types. On-call aircraft wait on ground alert or airborne alert until they get a request. Immediate close air support is for requests that are not in the plan.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
abort_criterialist of stringThis list contains the conditions in which the flights stop the on-call close air support (CAS).
areaAreaSelection | AirspaceSelectionyesThis field identifies the planning area or control measure in which the on-call close air support (CAS) operates.
availabilityWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the on-call close air support (CAS) is available.
briefCASBriefThis field gives the data of the mission brief for this on-call close air support (CAS) tasking. The brief refers to the records of the resource catalogue and does not copy them.
check_in_procedurestringThis field identifies the procedure that the flights follow at the start of the on-call close air support (CAS).
kind"on_call_cas"yesThe value identifies this record as an on-call close air support (CAS) tasking.
objectivestringThis field gives the result that the on-call close air support (CAS) is for, as free text.
report_refslist of stringThis list identifies the report definitions of the reports that the on-call close air support (CAS) sends. Each identifier refers to the reports map of the resource catalogue.
request_refslist of DocumentRefThis list contains the references to the air support requests that this tasking is for.
success_criteriastringThis field gives the conditions that show a satisfactory result of the on-call close air support (CAS), as free text.
supported_forcestringThis field gives the ground force that the on-call close air support (CAS) helps, as free text.
target_assignment_procedurestringThis field identifies the procedure that gives targets to the on-call close air support (CAS) flights.
tasking_agencystringThis field identifies the command and control agency that tasks the on-call close air support (CAS) flights.
terminal_controlenumThis field gives the type of terminal attack control for the on-call close air support (CAS), as one of the enumerated values.
  • type_1 This value identifies terminal attack control of type 1. The controller sees the attack aircraft and the target, and gives clearance for each attack.
  • type_2 This value identifies terminal attack control of type 2. The controller gives clearance for each attack, but cannot see the attack aircraft or the target when the aircraft releases the weapon.
  • type_3 This value identifies terminal attack control of type 3. The controller gives one clearance for more than one attack in one engagement, with attack restrictions.
  • assigned_by_controller The controller sets the type for each attack.

OnOrder

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
authoritystringThis field identifies the command and control agency that gives the order for the event.
conditionstringyesThis field gives the condition in which the authority gives the order for the event, as free text.
kind"on_order"yesThe value identifies this record as a time condition on order.

Package

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
commanderFlightSelectionThis field identifies the flight and the aircraft of the package commander.
coordinationlist of stringThis list contains the coordination instructions for the missions of the package.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
idstringyesThis field identifies this package. Other records and orders use it to refer to this package.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this package, for display.
objectivestringThis field gives the result that the package is for, as free text.
push_pointIdentifierThis field identifies the control point that is the push point of the package. The point shall have the role push.
push_timeAtTime | InWindow | BeforeTime | AfterTime | OnOrderThis field gives the time condition for the push of the package. The condition is at a time, in a window, not before a time, not after a time, or on order.
rendezvousstringThis field identifies the control point that is the rendezvous point of the package.
rendezvous_timeAtTime | InWindow | BeforeTime | AfterTime | OnOrderThis field gives the time condition for the rendezvous of the package. The condition is at a time, in a window, not before a time, not after a time, or on order.
time_on_targetAtTime | InWindow | BeforeTime | AfterTime | OnOrderThis field gives the time condition for the time on target of the package. The condition is at a time, in a window, not before a time, not after a time, or on order.

Patrol

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
abort_criterialist of stringThis list contains the conditions in which the flights stop the combat air patrol (CAP).
altitudeAltitudeBlockThis field gives the vertical limits of the patrol, as an altitude block with a floor and a ceiling.
areaAreaSelection | AirspaceSelectionyesThis field identifies the planning area or control measure that contains the combat air patrol (CAP) station.
briefAirToAirBriefThis field gives the data of the mission brief for this combat air patrol (CAP). The brief refers to the records of the resource catalogue and does not copy them.
coverage_responsibilitystringThis field gives the air threats and airspace that are the task of the combat air patrol (CAP), as free text.
engagement_instructionsstringThis field identifies the procedure that gives the commit criteria and the engagement conditions of the combat air patrol (CAP).
handoverstringThis field gives the instructions for the handover of the combat air patrol (CAP) station to the subsequent flight, as free text.
kind"cap"yesThe value identifies this record as a combat air patrol (CAP) tasking.
objectivestringThis field gives the result that the combat air patrol (CAP) is for, as free text.
report_refslist of stringThis list identifies the report definitions of the reports that the combat air patrol (CAP) sends. Each identifier refers to the reports map of the resource catalogue.
station_windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the combat air patrol (CAP) flights are on station.
success_criteriastringThis field gives the conditions that show a satisfactory result of the combat air patrol (CAP), as free text.

Period

A period is a time interval between two absolute date-times in the RFC 3339 format.

Type: Period

PersonnelRecovery

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
abort_criterialist of stringThis list contains the conditions in which the flights stop the personnel recovery.
availabilityWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the personnel recovery asset is available.
briefPersonnelRecoveryBriefThis field gives the data of the mission brief for this personnel recovery task. The brief refers to the records of the resource catalogue and does not copy them.
coordination_agencystringThis field identifies the command and control agency that coordinates the personnel recovery.
incidentstringyesThis field gives the event that isolates the personnel, as free text.
kind"personnel_recovery"yesThe value identifies this record as a personnel recovery tasking.
medical_requirementsstringThis field gives the medical treatment that is necessary for the isolated personnel, as free text.
objectivestringThis field gives the result that the personnel recovery is for, as free text.
recognition_procedurestringThis field identifies the procedure that lets the recovery force and the isolated personnel identify each other.
recovery_destinationstringThis field identifies the airfield, carrier or forward arming and refuelling point (FARP) that receives the personnel after the recovery.
recovery_methodenumThis field gives the method that the aircraft use for the recovery, as one of the enumerated values.
  • land The aircraft lands to get the personnel.
  • hoist The aircraft stays in the air and lifts the personnel into it.
  • pickup This value identifies a pickup of the personnel from the surface.
  • assigned_on_scene The commander at the site of the recovery sets the method.
report_refslist of stringThis list identifies the report definitions of the reports that the personnel recovery sends. Each identifier refers to the reports map of the resource catalogue.
roleenumThis field gives the role of the personnel recovery: search and rescue (SAR) or combat search and rescue (CSAR), as one of the enumerated values. The role is different from the recovery method. The role does not make a control measure.
  • search_and_rescue This value identifies search and rescue (SAR), which is aid to persons in distress in a permissive environment.
  • combat_search_and_rescue This value identifies combat search and rescue (CSAR), which is the recovery of isolated personnel during combat.
search_areaAreaSelection | AirspaceSelectionyesThis field identifies the planning area or control measure in which the recovery force does a search for the isolated personnel.
success_criteriastringThis field gives the conditions that show a satisfactory result of the personnel recovery, as free text.
tasking_procedurestringThis field identifies the procedure that tasks the recovery force.

PersonnelRecoveryBrief

A personnel recovery brief is the data that a recovery aircrew gets before the mission. The brief identifies the isolated personnel report (ISOPREP) of a survivor and contains no other data about the person.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
egress_routeIdentifierThis field identifies the route that the recovery flights use after the recovery.
holdinglist of ControlMeasureSelectionThis list identifies the orbits, points or zones that the recovery flights use to hold.
ingress_routeIdentifierThis field identifies the route that the recovery flights use to fly to the objective area.
on_scene_commanderIdentifierThis field identifies the flight that is the on-scene commander.
pickup_windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the recovery flights plan to be at the survivors.
remarksstringThis field gives the notes for the aircrews that are not in the other fields of this brief, as free text.
rescort_missionslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the rescue escort (RESCORT) missions that defend the recovery.
survivorslist of SurvivorThis list contains the isolated persons for this recovery.

PinnedRef

A pinned reference is a dependency on a local document that consumers examine by identifier and revision.

Type: PinnedRef

PreplannedAttack

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
abort_criterialist of stringThis list contains the conditions in which the flights stop the preplanned attack.
assignmentslist of AttackAssignmentyesThis list contains the attack assignments of the preplanned attack. Each assignment gives one target to one or more selected aircraft.
briefAttackBriefThis field gives the data of the mission brief for this preplanned attack. The brief refers to the records of the resource catalogue and does not copy them.
kind"preplanned_attack"yesThe value identifies this record as a preplanned attack tasking.
objectivestringThis field gives the result that the preplanned attack is for, as free text.
report_refslist of stringThis list identifies the report definitions of the reports that the preplanned attack sends. Each identifier refers to the reports map of the resource catalogue.
roleenumyesThis field gives the attack role of this preplanned attack, as one of the enumerated values. The value scheduled_cas is for close air support (CAS) at a scheduled time. On-call CAS and immediate close air support use the tasking for on-call CAS.
  • strike This value identifies an attack on surface targets in the plan.
  • sead This value identifies an attack that neutralizes or temporarily degrades enemy air defences on the surface, or destroys them.
  • dead This value identifies an attack that destroys enemy air defences on the surface. After the attack, they cannot engage aircraft again. This is an openAIX value with no doctrinal source.
  • scheduled_cas This value identifies preplanned close air support (CAS) at a time on target that the schedule gives. JP 3-09.3 (2014) paragraph 27 gives this type of CAS.
  • maritime_attack This value identifies an attack on maritime surface targets.
  • air_interdiction This value identifies air interdiction, which is an attack on enemy surface forces before they can engage friendly forces. The attack occurs at a distance from friendly forces.
success_criteriastringThis field gives the conditions that show a satisfactory result of the preplanned attack, as free text.
supporting_requestDocumentRefThis field gives a reference to the air support request that the preplanned attack is for.

ProcedureStep

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
actionstringyesThis field gives the task of this step, as free text.
completionstringThis field gives the condition at which this step is completed, as free text.
conditionstringThis field gives the condition in which this step is applicable, as free text.

RadioAssignment

Type: RadioAssignment

ReceiverSlot

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
flightstringyesThis field identifies the receiver flight that this entry gives a refuelling window to.
planned_offloadMassThis field gives the fuel that the tanker plans to give to the receiver flight in this window.
windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the receiver flight gets fuel from the tanker.

Reconnaissance

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
abort_criterialist of stringThis list contains the conditions in which the flights stop the reconnaissance.
briefReconnaissanceBriefThis field gives the data of the mission brief for this reconnaissance task. The brief refers to the records of the resource catalogue and does not copy them.
kind"reconnaissance"yesThe value identifies this record as a reconnaissance tasking.
objectivestringThis field gives the result that the reconnaissance is for, as free text.
report_refslist of stringThis list identifies the report definitions of the reports that the reconnaissance sends. Each identifier refers to the reports map of the resource catalogue.
reporting_procedurestringThis field identifies the procedure that the flights follow to send the information.
requirementslist of CollectionRequirementyesThis list contains the collection entries of the reconnaissance.
success_criteriastringThis field gives the conditions that show a satisfactory result of the reconnaissance, as free text.

ReconnaissanceBrief

A reconnaissance brief is the data for a reconnaissance mission. The collection entries of the tasking give the information, the sensors and the times.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
named_areaslist of ControlMeasureSelectionThis list identifies the named areas of interest, target areas of interest or reconnaissance areas that the aircraft look at.
remarksstringThis field gives the notes for the aircrews that are not in the other fields of this brief, as free text.
reportingReportingPlanThis field gives the reports of the reconnaissance aircraft, with the method and the time.

Recovery

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
alternateslist of stringThis list identifies the alternative operating locations that the flight may use for recovery. An operating location is an airfield, a carrier or a forward arming and refuelling point (FARP).
destinationstringyesThis field identifies the airfield, carrier or forward arming and refuelling point (FARP) that the flight goes back to.
planned_timestring (date-time) | OffsetThis field gives the time of the recovery, as the plan gives it. The value is a date and time, or an offset in minutes from the start of the order period.
procedurestringThis field identifies the procedure that the flight follows for recovery.
restrictionslist of stringThis list contains the limits and conditions that are applicable to this recovery.

Refueling

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
abort_criterialist of stringThis list contains the conditions in which the flights stop the refuelling task.
altitudeAltitudeBlockThis field gives the vertical limits of the refuelling task, as an altitude block with a floor and a ceiling.
areaAreaSelection | AirspaceSelectionyesThis field identifies the planning area or control measure that contains the refuelling track or anchor.
briefRefuelingBriefThis field gives the data of the mission brief for this refuelling task. The brief refers to the records of the resource catalogue and does not copy them.
channelstringThis field identifies the radio channel that connects the tanker and the receivers.
kind"refueling"yesThe value identifies this record as a refuelling tasking.
methodenumyesThis field gives the refuelling systems that the tanker supplies for this tasking: boom, drogue (probe and drogue) or both, as one of the enumerated values.
  • boom
  • drogue
  • both
objectivestringThis field gives the result that the refuelling task is for, as free text.
planned_offloadMassThis field gives the total fuel that the tanker plans to give on this tasking.
receiverslist of ReceiverSlotThis list contains the receiver flights in the schedule of the tanker, with their windows and the fuel that the tanker plans to give.
rendezvous_procedurestringThis field identifies the procedure that the receivers follow to go to the tanker.
report_refslist of stringThis list identifies the report definitions of the reports that the refuelling task sends. Each identifier refers to the reports map of the resource catalogue.
station_windowWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the tanker is on station.
success_criteriastringThis field gives the conditions that show a satisfactory result of the refuelling task, as free text.
tacanTACANThis field gives the channel, band and identifier of the Tactical Air Navigation (TACAN) of the tanker for this tasking, in air-to-air mode.
unassigned_receiver_policystringThis field gives the instruction for receivers that have no window in the schedule of the tanker, as free text.

RefuelingBrief

A refuelling brief is the data that tanker and receiver aircrews get before the refuelling. The tasking gives the track, the altitude block, the refuelling method, the channel, the Tactical Air Navigation (TACAN) and the receivers.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
anchorControlMeasureSelectionThis field identifies the orbit, point or air-to-air refuelling area that is the anchor of the refuelling track.
control_timeDateTimeThis field gives the time at which the tanker and the first receiver are at the rendezvous point.
receiver_altitudeAltitudeThis field gives the altitude at which the receivers join the tanker, as an altitude with its unit and reference.
remarksstringThis field gives the notes for the aircrews that are not in the other fields of this brief, as free text.
rendezvousenumThis field gives the type of rendezvous between the tanker and the receivers, as one of the enumerated values. The values are openAIX values with no doctrinal source.
  • point_parallel
  • en_route
  • anchor
rendezvous_pointControlMeasureSelectionThis field identifies the point that is the rendezvous point of the tanker and the receivers.

ReportingPlan

A report plan is the reports that an aircrew sends, with the method and the time of the reports.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
channelIdentifierThis field identifies the radio channel that is for the reports.
deadlineDateTimeThis field gives the time before which the aircrew sends the reports.
methodenumThis field gives the method that the aircrew uses to send the reports, as one of the enumerated values.
  • voice
  • datalink
  • chat
  • imagery_transfer
  • debrief
recipientIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that receives the reports.
reportslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the report definitions of the reports.

SCARBrief

A strike coordination and reconnaissance (SCAR) brief is the data for a SCAR mission.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
attack_missionslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the attack missions that the strike coordination and reconnaissance (SCAR) aircraft coordinate.
controllerControllerContactThis field gives the agency that controls the sequence of the attack flights, with its radio channels.
entry_pointslist of ControlMeasureSelectionThis list identifies the points that the attack flights fly through when they go into the area. Each point shall have the role control or ingress or gate.
holdinglist of ControlMeasureSelectionThis list identifies the orbits, points or zones that the attack flights use to hold.
remarksstringThis field gives the notes for the aircrews that are not in the other fields of this brief, as free text.
reportingReportingPlanThis field gives the reports of the strike coordination and reconnaissance (SCAR) aircraft, with the method and the time.
stacklist of objectThis list contains the altitude blocks of the holding stack, each for one attack mission.
target_prioritieslist of objectThis list contains the types of target that the strike coordination and reconnaissance (SCAR) aircraft look for, with their priorities.

SCLAlternative

authorityIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that gives approval for the standard conventional load (SCL) of this alternative.

sclstringyesThis field identifies the standard conventional load (SCL) of this alternative.

ScheduledLaunch

takeoffstring (date-time) | OffsetThis field gives the time at which the flight does the take-off. The value is a date and time, or an offset in minutes from the start of the order period.

SelfControl

FieldTypeRequiredDescription

Speed

A speed is a speed with its unit: knots, Mach number or kilometres in one hour.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
unitenumyesThis field gives the unit of the speed: knots, kilometres in one hour or Mach number, as one of the enumerated values. The suffix _ias identifies an indicated airspeed (IAS), and the suffix _tas identifies a true airspeed (TAS).
  • knots_ias
  • knots_tas
  • kmh_ias
  • kmh_tas
  • mach
valuenumberyesThis field gives the value of the speed, in the unit of unit.

SupportLink

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
coordinationstringThis field gives the coordination between this mission and the flight that helps it, as free text.
flightstringyesThis field identifies the flight that helps this mission.
roleenumyesThis field gives the role of the flight that helps this mission, as one of the enumerated values.
  • tanker This value identifies a tanker that gives fuel to the aircraft of the mission in flight.
  • escort This value identifies an escort that defends the mission against enemy aircraft.
  • airborne_control This value identifies an aircraft, such as an Airborne Warning and Control System (AWACS) aircraft, that gives surveillance and control to the mission.
  • suppression This value identifies a flight that neutralizes or degrades the enemy air defences that are a threat to the mission.
  • recovery This value identifies a personnel recovery flight that collects the aircrew of the mission when they become isolated.
  • controller This value identifies a joint terminal attack controller (JTAC) or an airborne forward air controller (FAC(A)) that gives terminal attack control to the mission.
  • other This value identifies a support role that the other values do not include.

Transport

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
abort_criterialist of stringThis list contains the conditions in which the flights stop the transport mission.
briefTransportBriefThis field gives the data of the mission brief for this transport task. The brief refers to the records of the resource catalogue and does not copy them.
delivery_methodenumThis field gives the method that moves the load out of the aircraft at the airfield that receives it, as one of the enumerated values.
  • land The aircraft lands, and then the load goes out of the aircraft.
  • airdrop The aircraft releases the load in flight.

destinationstringThis field identifies the airfield, carrier or forward arming and refuelling point (FARP) that receives the load.
ground_coordinationstringThis field identifies the command and control agency that coordinates the transport on the ground.

manifestManifestThis field gives the cargo and the persons on the aircraft of the transport mission.

pickupstringThis field identifies the airfield, carrier or forward arming and refuelling point (FARP) that the flight collects the load from.
pickup_timeAtTime | InWindow | BeforeTime | AfterTime | OnOrderThis field gives the time condition for the collection of the load. The condition is at a time, in a window, not before a time, not after a time, or on order.
report_refslist of stringThis list identifies the report definitions of the reports that the transport mission sends. Each identifier refers to the reports map of the resource catalogue.
roleenumThis field gives the function of the transport mission, as one of the enumerated values. The field delivery_method gives how the load goes out of the aircraft.
  • airlift This value identifies the movement of personnel and materiel by air.
  • aeromedical_evacuation This value identifies the movement of patients by air. Medical personnel control the patients and give them treatment en-route.
  • noncombatant_evacuation This value identifies airlift for a noncombatant evacuation operation.
  • humanitarian_assistance This value identifies airlift for a humanitarian assistance operation.
  • air_assault This value identifies an air assault. The aircraft are helicopters or tiltrotor aircraft. They move assault forces that engage enemy forces or hold terrain.
  • airdrop This value identifies an airdrop of personnel or materiel from aircraft in flight.
success_criteriastringThis field gives the conditions that show a satisfactory result of the transport mission, as free text.

TransportBrief

A transport brief is the data for a transport mission.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
air_assaultAirAssaultBriefThis field gives the air assault data. A transport task with the air_assault role shall have this field.
airdropAirdropBriefThis field gives the airdrop data. A transport task with the airdrop role shall have this field.
load_planlist of objectThis list contains the loads of the flights.
offloadTransferPointThis field gives the airfield, the time and the procedure at which the load goes out of the aircraft.
onloadTransferPointThis field gives the airfield, the time and the procedure at which the load goes into the aircraft.
patientsobjectThis field gives the numbers of patients and attendants for the aeromedical_evacuation role.
remarksstringThis field gives the notes for the aircrews that are not in the other fields of this brief, as free text.

WeaponLoad

A weapon load is the weapons of one flight for an attack assignment, with their fuze settings and altitudes.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
attack_headingBearingThis field gives the attack heading of the flight, as a bearing with its unit and reference.
flightIdentifierThis field identifies the flight that releases the weapons.
fuzeFuzeThis field gives the fuze setting of the weapons for this attack. If the weapon load does not give it, the fuze of the store in the standard conventional load (SCL) of the flight is applicable.
laser_codeLaserCodeThis field gives the laser code of the weapons for this attack. If the weapon load does not give it, the laser code of the standard conventional load (SCL) of the flight is applicable.
quantityintegerThis field gives the number of weapons for the flight. The quantity shall not be more than all aircraft of the flight have in their standard conventional load (SCL).
release_altitudeAltitudeThis field gives the altitude at which the flight releases the weapons, as an altitude with its unit and reference.
sclIdentifierThis field identifies the standard conventional load (SCL) that contains the weapons. It shall be an SCL of the flight.
storeIdentifieryesThis field identifies the store that is the weapon. When the flight has a standard conventional load (SCL), an SCL of the flight shall contain the store.

Window

A window is a time interval with limits that are absolute date-times or offsets from the period of the order that contains it.

Type: Window

resources

urn:openaix:schema:resources:0.2.0-draft.1

resources

A resource catalogue is a catalogue with a version that contains the resources that plans and control measures refer to. Each resource has a name.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
$schemastring (uri)This field identifies the schema that validates this document.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
kind"resources"yesThe value identifies this record as a resource catalogue.
metaMetadataThis field gives the identification, revision and issue data of this resource catalogue.
resourcesResourceDatayesThis field contains the resources of this catalogue, in maps. Each map identifies its items by their identifiers.
schema_version"0.2.0-draft.1"This field gives the version of the openAIX schema that this resource catalogue agrees with.

AfterTime

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
atstring (date-time) | OffsetyesThis field gives the time before which the event does not occur. The value is a date and time, or an offset in minutes from the start of the order period.
kind"not_before"yesThe value identifies this record as a time condition not before a time.

Aimpoint

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
briefinglist of AttachmentThis list contains the attachments for the brief on this aimpoint. An attachment is an image, a map, a document or a link.
descriptionstringThis field gives the data about this aimpoint and its local conditions, as free text.
elevationElevationThis field gives the elevation of the aimpoint above mean sea level (MSL), as an elevation with its unit.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
namestringThis field gives the name of this aimpoint, for display.
positionGeoPointyesThis field gives the geographic position of the aimpoint, as latitude and longitude.

AircraftType

An aircraft type is a type and version of aircraft that flights and standard conventional loads (SCLs) refer to. The type names of simulators are in extensions.sim.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
categoryenumThis field gives the class of the aircraft type, as one of the enumerated values.
  • airplane
  • helicopter
  • unmanned
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this aircraft type, for display. An example is F-16C Fighting Falcon Block 50.

AirspaceSelection

Type: ControlMeasureSelection

Altitude

An altitude is a vertical position with its unit and its reference: mean sea level (MSL), above ground level (AGL) or flight level (FL).

Type: Altitude

AltitudeBlock

An altitude block is a vertical band between a floor and a ceiling. The floor can be the surface, and the ceiling can have no limit.

Type: AltitudeBlock

Area

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
activeWindowThis field gives the time interval during which the area is active. The value is a schedule, or one continuous period.
altitudeAltitudeBlockThis field gives the vertical limits of the area, as an altitude block with a floor and a ceiling.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
geometryGeometry_circle | Geometry_polygon | Geometry_corridor | Geometry_rectangle | Geometry_ellipse | Geometry_geojson_polygonyesThis field gives the horizontal geometry of the area: a circle, a polygon, a corridor, a rectangle or an ellipse.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this area, for display.
restrictionslist of stringThis list contains the limits and conditions that are applicable to this area.

AreaSelection

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
areastringyesThis field identifies the planning area that this selection contains.

AreaTarget

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
areaAreaSelection | AirspaceSelectionyesThis field identifies the planning area or control measure that contains the area target.
briefinglist of AttachmentThis list contains the attachments for the brief on this area target. An attachment is an image, a map, a document or a link.
descriptionstringThis field gives the data about this target and the conditions of the operation, as free text.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
identification_featureslist of stringThis list contains the signs that identify this area target.
kind"area"yesThe value identifies this record as an area target.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this area target, for display.
restrictionslist of stringThis list contains the limits and conditions on tasks against this target.
sourceDocumentRefThis field identifies the source document. The reference identifies the document. It may also give a revision and a locator.
target_numberstringThis field identifies this area target in target lists. An example is CS-0001.
target_populationstringThis field gives the types of target objects in the target area, as free text.
threat_refslist of stringThis list identifies the possible threats that are applicable to this area target.

AtTime

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
atstring (date-time) | OffsetyesThis field gives the time at which the event occurs. The value is a date and time, or an offset in minutes from the start of the order period.
kind"at"yesThe value identifies this record as a time condition at a time.
tolerance_secondsnumberThis field gives the maximum time interval between the event and the time in at, in seconds. The limit is applicable before and after that time.

Attachment

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
captionstringThis field gives the short text that goes with this attachment, as free text.
kindenumyesThis field gives the type of attachment, as one of the enumerated values.
  • image This value identifies an image file that shows an area, an object or a plan.
  • map This value identifies a file that shows a map or a chart of an area.
  • document This value identifies a file with written text, for example an order or a brief.
  • link This value identifies a link to an external resource.
pathstringyesThis field gives the path or link of the file of the attachment, as free text. A path starts at the folder of the document that contains the attachment.
titlestringThis field gives the title of this attachment, as free text.

BeforeTime

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
atstring (date-time) | OffsetyesThis field gives the time after which the event does not occur. The value is a date and time, or an offset in minutes from the start of the order period.
kind"not_after"yesThe value identifies this record as a time condition not after a time.

Channel

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
frequencyFrequency & anyyesThis field gives the frequency of the channel, as a frequency with its unit.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this channel, for display.
notesstringThis field gives the notes about this channel, as free text.
usagestringThis field gives the function of the channel, as free text.

CommPlan

A communication plan is a named set of radio assignments that several flights can use.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
assignmentslist of RadioAssignmentyesThis list contains the radio assignments of the plan.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this communication plan, for display.

DocumentRef

A document reference is a document that a record refers to. Consumers do not get the document automatically through a network.

Type: DocumentRef

Emitter

An emitter is an air defence radar with the system that it is a part of, its position and its threat ring. Briefs and orders refer to the emitter by its identifier and do not copy it. A consumer shows the threat ring as a circle around the position of the emitter. An emitter shall have a position or simulator bindings.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
detection_rangeLengthThis field gives the largest range at which the radar can find an aircraft, as a length with its unit.
engagement_ceilingVerticalLimitThis field gives the ceiling of the engagement envelope of the system: an altitude with its reference, or no limit.
engagement_floorVerticalLimitThis field gives the floor of the engagement envelope of the system: an altitude with its reference, or the surface.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this emitter. Each emitter in the resource catalogue has a different identifier. Briefs, threats and orders use it to refer to this emitter.
last_seenDateTimeThis field gives the time of of the last report of the emitter.
max_engagement_rangeLengthyesThis field gives the largest range at which the system can engage an aircraft, as a length with its unit.
measureslist of ControlMeasureSelectionThis list identifies the missile engagement zones, missile arcs and the other measures of air defence that are for this emitter. Each missile arc shall start at the emitter, and each engagement zone shall contain it.
min_engagement_rangeLengthThis field gives the smallest range at which the system can engage an aircraft, as a length with its unit.
mobilityenumyesThis field gives the mobility of the emitter, as one of the enumerated values.
  • fixed This value identifies a system that does not move.
  • mobile This value identifies a system that can fire while it moves or a short time after it stops.
  • relocatable This value identifies a system that can fire only from a fire position, after it moves there.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this emitter site, such as Cobalt SA-6 battery, for display.
native_designationstringThis field gives the designation of the weapon system in the armed forces that operate it, such as 2K12 Kub, as free text.
positionGeoPointThis field gives the geographic position of the emitter, as latitude and longitude. For a mobile emitter, the position is the position from the last report.
radar_reporting_namestringThis field gives the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) reporting name of the radar, such as Straight Flush, as free text.
radar_roleslist of enumThis list contains the functions of the radar in its air defence unit. Appendix B of the DCS F-16C Early Access Guide gives these types.
  • early_warning
  • surveillance
  • target_acquisition
  • target_tracking
  • target_illumination
  • fire_control
  • ranging
  • continuous_wave_acquisition
  • search_and_tracking
radar_system_idstringThis field gives the designation of the radar, such as 1S91, as free text. Many radars have only a reporting name.
remarksstringThis field gives the notes about the emitter, as free text.
reporting_namestringThis field gives the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) reporting name of the weapon system, such as Gainful, as free text.
rwr_symbolstringThis field gives the symbol that the radar warning receiver (RWR) shows for the radar, for display, as free text.
statusenumThis field gives the condition of the emitter from the last report, as one of the enumerated values.
  • active This value identifies an emitter that transmits.
  • silent This value identifies an emitter that does not transmit at this time.
  • suspected This value identifies an emitter that one report gives and that no other source agrees with.
  • destroyed This value identifies an emitter that an assessment shows as destroyed.
system_idstringyesThis field gives the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) designation of the weapon system, such as SA-6, as free text.

FixedTarget

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
aimpointsobjectyesThis map contains the aimpoint entries of the fixed target. The key of each item is its identifier.
briefinglist of AttachmentThis list contains the attachments for the brief on this fixed target. An attachment is an image, a map, a document or a link.
descriptionstringThis field gives the data about this target and the conditions of the operation, as free text.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
identification_featureslist of stringThis list contains the signs that identify this fixed target.
kind"fixed"yesThe value identifies this record as a fixed target.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this fixed target, for display.
restrictionslist of stringThis list contains the limits and conditions on tasks against this target.
sourceDocumentRefThis field identifies the source document. The reference identifies the document. It may also give a revision and a locator.
target_numberstringThis field identifies this fixed target in target lists. An example is CS-0001.
threat_refslist of stringThis list identifies the possible threats that are applicable to this fixed target.

GeoPoint

A geographic point is a position in WGS 84 decimal degrees. An adapter is necessary for the Cartesian coordinates of a simulator.

Type: GeoPoint

InWindow

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
kind"window"yesThe value identifies this record as a time condition in a window.
windowWindowyesThis field gives the time interval during which the event occurs.

LastKnownPosition

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
as_ofDateTimeThis field gives the time of the last known position.
positionGeoPointyesThis field gives the geographic position of the last known position, as latitude and longitude.

MobileTarget

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
briefinglist of AttachmentThis list contains the attachments for the brief on this mobile target. An attachment is an image, a map, a document or a link.
descriptionstringThis field gives the data about this target and the conditions of the operation, as free text.
expected_movementstringThis field gives the possible movement of the mobile target, as free text.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
identification_featureslist of stringThis list contains the signs that identify this mobile target.
kind"mobile"yesThe value identifies this record as a mobile target.
last_knownLastKnownPositionThis field gives the last known position of the mobile target, with its time.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this mobile target, for display.
restrictionslist of stringThis list contains the limits and conditions on tasks against this target.
search_areaAreaSelection | AirspaceSelectionThis field identifies the planning area or control measure in which flights do a search for the mobile target.
sourceDocumentRefThis field identifies the source document. The reference identifies the document. It may also give a revision and a locator.
target_numberstringThis field identifies this mobile target in target lists. An example is CS-0001.
threat_refslist of stringThis list identifies the possible threats that are applicable to this mobile target.

Offset

An offset is a number of minutes from the start of the period of the air tasking order (ATO) that contains it. The value can be less than zero.

Type: Offset

OnOrder

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
authoritystringThis field identifies the command and control agency that gives the order for the event.
conditionstringyesThis field gives the condition in which the authority gives the order for the event, as free text.
kind"on_order"yesThe value identifies this record as a time condition on order.

Procedure

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
referenceslist of DocumentRefThis list contains the documents that the procedure refers to.
stepslist of ProcedureStepyesThis list contains the steps of the procedure, in order. Units do the steps in their sequence.
titlestringyesThis field gives the title of the procedure, as free text.

ProcedureStep

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
actionstringyesThis field gives the task of this step, as free text.
completionstringThis field gives the condition at which this step is completed, as free text.
conditionstringThis field gives the condition in which this step is applicable, as free text.

RadioAssignment

Type: RadioAssignment

ReportDefinition

A report definition is a report that a unit should send. ATP 6-02.x and the standard operating procedure (SOP) of the unit give the report.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
channelIdentifierThis field identifies the radio channel that is for the report.
classificationClassificationLevelThis field gives the highest security classification of the data in the report, as one of the enumerated values.
format_refstringThis field gives the reference to the format of the report, as free text. Examples are a paragraph of a standard operating procedure (SOP) and a USMTF format.
frequencystringThis field gives the interval at which units send the report, such as Daily NLT 0600 or On event, as free text.
mediumenumThis field gives the transmission method of the report, as one of the enumerated values.
  • voice
  • datalink
  • chat
  • message
  • debrief
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this report, for display. Examples are SITREP, LOGSTAT and CASREP.
precedenceenumThis field gives the message precedence of the report, as JP 6-0 gives it, as one of the enumerated values.
  • flash
  • immediate
  • priority
  • routine
recipientIdentifierThis field identifies the command and control agency that receives the report.
submitterstringThis field gives the unit or staff section that has the task to send the report, as free text.
triggerstringThis field gives the event or schedule that causes a unit to send the report, as free text.

ResourceData

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
agenciesmap of c2-agencyThis map contains the command and control agencies. The key of each item is its identifier.
aircraft_typesmap of AircraftTypeThis map contains the aircraft types. The key of each item is its identifier.
areasobjectThis map contains the planning areas that are not control measures. The key of each item is its identifier.
channelsobjectThis map contains the radio channels. The key of each item is its identifier.
comm_plansmap of CommPlanThis map contains the communication plans, which are named sets of radio assignments that flights share. The key of each item is its identifier.
control_measuresMeasureCatalogueThis map contains the control measures. The key of each item is its identifier.
emittersmap of EmitterThis map contains the emitters, which are air defence radars with their systems and threat rings. The key of each item is its identifier.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
facsmap of facThis map contains the forward air controllers. The key of each item is its identifier. A controller contact of an air tasking order (ATO) can identify a forward air controller of this map. An identifier shall not be in agencies and in facs.
holdingsmap of holdingThis map contains the hold records to which airfields and instrument procedures refer. The key of each item is its identifier.
instrument_proceduresmap of procedureThis map contains the instrument procedures that airfields refer to. The key of each item is its identifier.
localizersmap of localizerThis map contains the localizers to which airfields and the ends of runways refer. The key of each item is its identifier.
msasmap of msaThis map contains the records of a minimum safe altitude to which airfields and instrument procedures refer. The key of each item is its identifier.
notamsmap of notamThis map contains the notice to air missionses (NOTAMs) that planners write before the operation. The key of each item is its identifier.
pattern_profilesmap of TrafficPatternThis map contains the traffic pattern profiles that airfields refer to. The key of each item is its identifier. A traffic pattern profile in this map shall not refer to a traffic pattern profile.
placesmap of airfieldThis map contains the operating locations for departure, recovery, diversion and transport: airfields, carriers and forward arming and refuelling points (FARPs). The key of each item is its identifier.
proceduresobjectThis map contains the procedures. The key of each item is its identifier.
reportsobjectThis map contains the report definitions that taskings refer to in their report requirements. The key of each item is its identifier.
routesobjectThis map contains the routes. The key of each item is its identifier.
sclsmap of sclThis map contains the standard conventional loads (SCLs). The key of each item is its identifier.
storesobjectThis map contains the weapons, pods, tanks and other stores. The key of each item is its identifier.
targetsobjectThis map contains the fixed targets, mobile targets and area targets. The key of each item is its identifier.
threatsobjectThis map contains the possible threats. The key of each item is its identifier.

Route

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
contingencieslist of stringThis list contains the instructions for contingencies on the route.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this route, for display.
pointslist of RoutePointyesThis list contains the points of the route, in order. The points are in the sequence of the flight.

RoutePoint

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
actionenumThis field gives the flight phase at this route point, as one of the enumerated values.
  • departure The flight starts its route from the departure airfield at this point.
  • transit This value identifies a transit between two points.
  • ingress This value identifies the ingress to the task area.
  • egress This value identifies the egress from the task area.
  • hold The flight holds at the point.
  • approach At this point, the flight starts its approach to an airfield for the landing.
  • recovery At this point, the flight starts to go back to an airfield after the task.
altitudeAltitudeThis field gives the altitude that the order gives for this route point, as an altitude with its unit and reference.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
idstringyesThis field identifies this route point. Other records and orders use it to refer to this route point.
instructionslist of stringThis list contains the instructions for this route point.
namestringThis field gives the name of this route point, for display.
numberintegerThis field gives the steerpoint number of this route point in the aircraft, from 1.
positionGeoPointyesThis field gives the geographic position of the route point, as latitude and longitude.
speedSpeedThis field gives the speed that the plan gives for this route point, as a speed with its unit.
timingAtTime | InWindow | BeforeTime | AfterTime | OnOrderThis field gives the time condition for the flight at this point. The condition is at a time, in a window, not before a time, not after a time, or on order.

Speed

A speed is a speed with its unit: knots, Mach number or kilometres in one hour.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
unitenumyesThis field gives the unit of the speed: knots, kilometres in one hour or Mach number, as one of the enumerated values. The suffix _ias identifies an indicated airspeed (IAS), and the suffix _tas identifies a true airspeed (TAS).
  • knots_ias
  • knots_tas
  • kmh_ias
  • kmh_tas
  • mach
valuenumberyesThis field gives the value of the speed, in the unit of unit.

Store

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
familystringThis field gives the store family, such as AIM-120 for an AIM-120C, as free text. A load variant can use a different store of the same store family.
kindenumyesThis field gives the type of store, as one of the enumerated values.
  • weapon This value identifies a weapon, such as a missile, that the aircraft fires or drops.
  • pod This value identifies a pod with sensors or other equipment, such as a targeting pod. The aircraft does not release it.
  • tank This value identifies an external fuel tank.
  • rack This value identifies a store that has other stores on it.
  • cargo This value identifies a load in the aircraft that goes to other units.
  • other This value identifies a store that the other values do not include.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this store, for display.
notesstringThis field gives the notes about this store, as free text.
roleenumThis field gives the function of the pod, as one of the enumerated values. Only a store of the pod type shall have a role.
  • targeting This value identifies a pod that finds, tracks and designates targets.
  • navigation This value identifies a pod with sensors for navigation at night or at low altitude.
  • self_protection_jamming This value identifies a jammer that gives protection to the aircraft that has it.
  • tactical_jamming This value identifies a jammer that attacks enemy radars and radios for other aircraft.
  • emitter_targeting This value identifies a pod that finds enemy radars and gives their positions to weapons such as the high-speed anti-radiation missile (HARM).
  • datalink This value identifies a pod that sends data to the weapons of the aircraft or receives data from them.
  • reconnaissance This value identifies a pod that collects images or other data for reconnaissance.
  • other This value identifies a pod with a function that the other values do not include.

Threat

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
airfieldIdentifierThis field identifies the operating location that is the base of the threat, for example the airfield of enemy aircraft.
areaAreaSelection | AirspaceSelectionThis field identifies the planning area or control measure in which the threat operates.
as_ofDateTimeThis field gives the time of the threat data.
briefinglist of AttachmentThis list contains the attachments for the brief on this threat. An attachment is an image, a map, a document or a link.
descriptionstringThis field gives the data about this threat and its local conditions, as free text.
emitterslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the emitters that are a part of this threat.
expected_activitystringThis field gives the possible operations of the threat, as free text.
kindenumyesThis field gives the type of threat, as one of the enumerated values.
  • air This value identifies enemy aircraft.
  • air_defense This value identifies surface-to-air weapons, such as surface-to-air missiles (SAMs) and air defence guns.
  • surface This value identifies surface forces other than air defence.
  • electromagnetic This value identifies an electromagnetic threat to radio or radar equipment.
  • environmental This value identifies a dangerous condition from the weather or the terrain.
  • other This value identifies a threat that the other values do not include.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this threat, for display.
sourceDocumentRefThis field identifies the source document. The reference identifies the document. It may also give a revision and a locator.
systemstringThis field gives the system of the threat, such as 2K12 Kub, as free text.

Window

A window is a time interval with limits that are absolute date-times or offsets from the period of the order that contains it.

Type: Window

openAIX ACO

urn:openaix:schema:aco:0.2.0-draft.1

aco

An airspace control order (ACO) is an order that activates or deactivates control measures for a specified period. It also gives the function and the restrictions of each control measure that it refers to.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
$schemastring (uri)This field identifies the schema that validates this document.
assignmentslist of anyyesThis list contains the instructions with a time limit that activate control measures or deactivate them, or give them a function, in the order period.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
instructionslist of stringThis list contains the general instructions for airspace control that are applicable to the full order.
kind"aco"yesThe value identifies this record as an airspace control order (ACO).
metaMetadataThis field gives the identification, revision and issue data of this airspace control order (ACO).
periodPeriodyesThis field gives the time interval during which the order is in effect. Each assignment is in this interval.
referenceslist of DocumentRefThis list contains the coordination documents for the order, such as the airspace control plan, the air tasking order (ATO) or the special instructions (SPINS).
resourcesResourceDataThis field contains a resource catalogue in the order. The catalogue resolves the references to control measures, agencies, channels and routes of the order. The order shall have resources or resources_ref, but not the two fields.
resources_refResourceRefThis field identifies the external resource catalogue that resolves the references of the order. More than one document can use the same catalogue. The reference identifies the catalogue and gives its revision. The order shall have resources or resources_ref, but not the two fields.
schema_version"0.2.0-draft.1"This field gives the version of the openAIX schema that this airspace control order (ACO) agrees with.

Airfield

urn:openaix:schema:airfield:0.2.0-draft.1

airfield

An airfield is an aircraft operating location: a fixed airfield with runways, an aircraft carrier or a forward arming and refuelling point (FARP). The record has the position, the radio frequencies, the traffic pattern and the links to navigation records.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
$schemastringThis field identifies the schema that validates this document.
approach_instructionslist of stringThis list contains the local arrival and approach instructions for mission aircraft, as free text.
atisAtisThis field gives the static data of the automatic terminal information service (ATIS) broadcast for a simulator. The ATIS frequency is an item of frequencies with the role atis. The simulator gives the weather.
calm_wind_runwayRunwayDesignatorThis field gives the designator of the calm wind runway: the runway end that the airfield uses for a calm wind. The value shall be the designator of an end of a runway of this airfield.
carrierCarrierThis field gives the data of an aircraft carrier. The data are the hull number, the Tactical Air Navigation (TACAN), the instrument carrier landing system (ICLS) channel and the case recovery data. A record with a different kind shall not have this field.
controlling_agencyIdentifierThis field identifies the agency that controls the air traffic at the airfield.
elevationElevationThis field gives the published elevation of the airfield above mean sea level, as an elevation with its unit.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
frequencieslist of StationFrequencyThis list contains the radio frequencies of the stations at the operating location. Each item has the role of the station, for example tower, ground or automatic terminal information service (ATIS).
holdingslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the hold records that are for holding patterns at this airfield. When a hold record in this list identifies an airfield, that airfield shall be this airfield.
hung_ordnance_runwayRunwayDesignatorThis field gives the designator of the runway end that aircraft with hung ordnance use for landing. A base publishes it in its local emergency procedures. The value shall be the designator of an end of a runway of this airfield. A carrier record shall not have this field.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this airfield. Other resources and orders use this stable identifier to refer to this airfield.
identstringThis field identifies this airfield in published data. Examples are the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) location indicator and the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) identifier.
kindenumyesThis field gives the type of the operating location, as one of the enumerated values. An airfield record shall have position, elevation and one or more runways. A farp record shall have position and elevation, and no runways. A carrier record shall have carrier, and no runways or landing pads.
  • airfield This value identifies a fixed airfield with one or more runways.
  • carrier This value identifies an aircraft carrier. Its position comes from its unit in the simulator.
  • farp This value identifies a forward arming and refuelling point (FARP) with landing pads.
localizerslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the localizers that are for the runways of this airfield. When a localizer in this list identifies an airfield, that airfield shall be this airfield.
magnetic_variation_degnumberThis field gives the magnetic variation at the airfield, in degrees. Values for east are more than zero, and values for west are less than zero.
msaslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the records of a minimum safe altitude that are for this airfield. When a record of a minimum safe altitude in this list identifies an airfield, that airfield shall be this airfield.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this airfield, for display.
navaidslist of ControlMeasureSelectionThis list contains the navigation aids of the airfield: VOR, VORTAC, TACAN, NDB or DME stations. The Tactical Air Navigation (TACAN) of a fixed airfield or a forward arming and refuelling point (FARP) is in this list. It is a TACAN or VORTAC station. When a navigation aid in this list identifies an airfield, that airfield shall be this airfield.
operating_hoursWeeklyScheduleThis field gives the hours of each week, in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), when the operating location is open. The schedule is the same for all weeks, and the location is not open at other times. When the record does not have this field, the location is always open.
padslist of PadThis list contains the landing pads of a forward arming and refuelling point (FARP) or of a helicopter area of an airfield.
parkinglist of StandThis list contains the parking stands of the operating location.
positionGeoPointThis field gives the geographic position of the airfield reference point, as latitude and longitude.
procedureslist of IdentifierThis list identifies the instrument procedures that start or stop at this airfield: standard instrument departure (SID), standard terminal arrival route (STAR) or approach. When a procedure in this list identifies an airfield, that airfield shall be this airfield.
provenanceProvenanceThis field gives the provenance of this airfield as structured data: how the data were made, the authority, the aeronautical information regulation and control (AIRAC) cycle and the tool that made them.
resources_refResourceRefThis field identifies the resource catalogue that resolves the references of this airfield. The reference gives the identifier and the revision of the catalogue.
runwayslist of runwayThis list contains the runways of the airfield. Each item is one runway with its two ends.
sourcestringThis field gives the source of this record. The value gives the authority that publishes the data, and the cycle, for example FAA CIFP cycle 2610. A record that an author writes does not have this field. The field provenance gives the same facts as structured data.
taxiTaxiGraphThis field gives the taxi graph of the airfield: the taxi nodes, with their names, and the edges between them. The graph does not give the shape of the taxiways.
traffic_patternTrafficPatternThis field gives the traffic pattern of the airfield. Its values are the default values. A runway end can give different values for that end.
transition_altitudeAltitudeThis field gives the transition altitude, as an altitude with its unit and reference. At or below this altitude, the vertical position of an aircraft is its altitude above mean sea level.
useenumThis field gives the use of the operating location: civil, military, or joint civil and military use, as one of the enumerated values. Aerodrome data publish it.
  • civil This value identifies an operating location for civil aviation.
  • military This value identifies an operating location of armed forces.
  • joint This value identifies an operating location that civil aviation and armed forces use together.

Atis

Automatic terminal information service (ATIS) data is the static data that a simulator puts into the ATIS broadcast. The weather is not part of this data.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
remarkslist of stringThis list contains the notes at the end of the broadcast, as free text.
runway_in_useRunwayDesignatorThis field gives the designator of the active runway end in the broadcast. The value shall be the designator of an end of a runway of this airfield.
transition_levelAltitude & anyThis field gives the transition level that the broadcast gives, as an altitude with its unit and reference.

Carrier

An aircraft carrier is a record with the identifier and the recovery data of an aircraft carrier. The carrier moves, and thus its position comes from its unit in the simulator.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
aclsbooleanThe value is true when the carrier has an automatic carrier landing system (ACLS) for the recovery of aircraft. The value is false when the carrier has no ACLS.
case_recoveryCaseRecoveryThis field gives the case recovery that the carrier plans, and the marshal data.
hull_numberstringyesThis field identifies this carrier as its hull number. An example is CVN-72.
icls_channelintegerThis field gives the channel of the instrument carrier landing system (ICLS) of the carrier, from 1 to 20.
link4Frequency & anyThis field gives the frequency of the Link 4 data link of the carrier, in megahertz.
recovery_windowslist of RecoveryWindowThis list contains the recovery windows of the carrier, in order.
tacanTACANThis field gives the channel and the band of the Tactical Air Navigation (TACAN) of the carrier. The TACAN moves with the ship, and thus it is not a fixed navigation aid in navaids.

CaseRecovery

A case recovery is the recovery procedure that a carrier plans, and the position of its marshal stack. The marshal frequency is an item of frequencies with the role marshal.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
caseenumyesThis field gives the case recovery that the carrier plans, as one of the enumerated values.
  • case_i This value identifies the Case I recovery for visual conditions by day.
  • case_ii This value identifies the Case II recovery: a descent in instrument conditions to visual conditions below the cloud.
  • case_iii This value identifies the Case III recovery for instrument conditions, or for a recovery at night.
marshal_altitudeAltitude & anyThis field gives the altitude of the lowest level of the marshal stack, above mean sea level, as an altitude with its unit and reference.
marshal_distanceLengthThis field gives the distance of the marshal stack from the carrier, as a length with its unit.
marshal_radialBearingThis field gives the radial from the carrier on which the marshal stack is, as a bearing with its unit and reference.

GoAround

A go-around is the local climb-out instructions for a go-around. When the record has no heading, aircraft fly the runway heading.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
altitudeAltitude & anyThis field gives the altitude to which aircraft climb on a go-around, as an altitude with its unit and reference. The reference is above ground level or mean sea level.
headingBearingThis field gives the heading that aircraft fly on a go-around, as a bearing with its unit and reference.

InitialPoint

An initial point is the start of the initial leg of an overhead pattern. It is a point with a name, or a distance and a bearing from the runway threshold.

Type: object | object

Pad

A pad is one prepared surface of the operating location: a helicopter or vertical landing pad, or a ground pad for aircraft with live ordnance or hot brakes. A pad without a use is a landing pad.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
namestringThis field gives the name of this pad, for display.
positionGeoPointyesThis field gives the geographic position of the centre of the pad, as latitude and longitude.
uselist of enumThis list contains the uses of the ground pad. One pad can have more than one use.
  • hot_brake
  • hung_ordnance
  • arm_dearm

PatternSet

Pattern values are the values of a traffic pattern for one aircraft category. Each value is optional.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
altitudeAltitude & anyThis field gives the altitude of the rectangular traffic pattern, as an altitude with its unit and reference. The reference is above ground level or mean sea level.
break_pointenumThis field gives the position along the runway at which aircraft start the overhead break, as one of the enumerated values.
  • approach_end The overhead break starts above the approach end of the runway.
  • midfield The overhead break starts above the middle of the runway.
  • departure_end The overhead break starts above the departure end of the runway.
departure_ceilingAltitude & anyThis field gives the highest altitude for departures while aircraft use the overhead pattern, as an altitude with its unit and reference. The reference is above ground level or mean sea level.
directionenumThis field gives the direction of the turns in the traffic pattern, as one of the enumerated values.
  • left Each turn in the pattern is a left turn.
  • right Each turn in the pattern is a right turn.
go_aroundGoAroundThis field gives the go-around instructions of the pattern.
initiallist of InitialPointThis list contains the initial points of the overhead pattern.
overhead_altitudeAltitude & anyThis field gives the altitude of the initial leg and of the overhead break, as an altitude with its unit and reference. The reference is above ground level or mean sea level.
reentryReentryThis field gives the re-entry procedure of the overhead pattern.
sfoSimulatedFlameoutThis field gives the simulated flameout (SFO) pattern. When the record has no SFO pattern, the pattern values do not give one.

RecoveryWindow

A recovery window is a time interval in which the carrier recovers aircraft with one case recovery.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
brcBearingThis field gives the base recovery course, which is the heading of the carrier during the recovery, as a bearing with its unit and reference.
caseenumyesThis field gives the case recovery in the window, as one of the enumerated values.
  • case_i
  • case_ii
  • case_iii
windowWindowyesThis field gives the time interval during which the carrier recovers aircraft.

Reentry

A re-entry is the procedure that aircraft use to enter the overhead pattern again. It has the point or the name of the re-entry point, and its altitude.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
altitudeAltitude & anyThis field gives the altitude of the re-entry, as an altitude with its unit and reference. The reference is above ground level or mean sea level.
namestringThis field gives the name of the re-entry point, when no point record identifies it, as free text.
pointControlMeasureSelectionThis field identifies the point at which aircraft start the re-entry.

SimulatedFlameout

A simulated flameout pattern is the altitudes of the high key and the low key of a simulated flameout (SFO) pattern. The base publishes them.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
high_keyAltitudeBlock & anyyesThis field gives the vertical limits of the high key, as an altitude block with a floor and a ceiling. The block gives the altitudes that aircraft can use at the high key.
low_keyAltitudeBlock & anyyesThis field gives the vertical limits of the low key, as an altitude block with a floor and a ceiling. The block gives the altitudes that aircraft can use at the low key.

Stand

A parking stand is one parking position for one aircraft.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
categoryenumThis field gives the largest aircraft class that can use the parking stand, as one of the enumerated values.
  • fighter This value identifies fighters and other small aircraft.
  • medium This value identifies aircraft of moderate dimensions, for example a transport aircraft with two engines.
  • heavy This value identifies heavy aircraft, for example a tanker aircraft or a large transport aircraft.
  • helicopter This value identifies a stand or a taxiway only for helicopters, not for fixed-wing aircraft.
extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
headingBearingThis field gives the heading of an aircraft on the parking stand, as a bearing with its unit and reference.
helicoptersbooleanThe value is true when helicopters can also use the parking stand.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this parking stand. Each parking stand in its airfield has a different identifier. A taxi node refers to the parking stand with this identifier.
lengthLengthThis field gives the length of the parking stand, as a length with its unit.
namestringThis field gives the name of the parking stand in the radio calls of air traffic control (ATC), for example 41, as free text.
positionGeoPointyesThis field gives the geographic position of the centre of the parking stand, as latitude and longitude.
rampstringThis field gives the name of the ramp or apron of the parking stand, as free text.
shelterbooleanThe value is true when the parking stand is in an aircraft shelter.
widthLengthThis field gives the width of the parking stand, as a length with its unit.

StationFrequency

A station frequency is one radio frequency of a station at an operating location, with the role of the station.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
callsignstringThis field gives the radio callsign of the station, for example Muwaffaq Salti Tower, as free text.
frequencyFrequency & anyyesThis field gives the frequency of the station, as a frequency with its unit. The unit is megahertz, and the field modulation is mandatory.
