extensionsExtensionsThis field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group sim contains the simulator data of the record.
idIdentifieryesThis field identifies this airspace coordination volume. Other records and orders use it to refer to this airspace coordination volume.
namestringyesThis field gives the name of this airspace coordination volume, for display.
notesstringThis field gives the notes about this airspace coordination volume, as free text.
purposestringThis field gives the task or objective of this airspace coordination volume, as free text.
resources_refResourceRefThis field identifies the resource catalogue that resolves the references of this airspace coordination volume. The reference gives the identifier and the revision of the catalogue.
restrictionslist of stringThis list contains the conditions that control the operations in this airspace coordination volume.
typeenumyesThis field gives the catalogue code of this control measure, as one of the enumerated values. The code identifies the definition of the control measure in doctrine. The catalogue of control measures gives its class and the source of its definition.
  • AARA An air-to-air refuelling area (AARA) is airspace of defined dimensions for air-to-air refuelling operations. Other airspace users stay out of it, unless they coordinate with its controlling authority.
  • ACCA An airborne command and control area (ACCA) is airspace of defined dimensions, only for aircraft that do battlefield command and control.
  • AEWA An airborne early warning area (AEWA) is airspace of defined dimensions, only for aircraft that do airborne early warning.
  • ACAR An airspace control area (ACAR) is airspace with lateral limits that follow the boundaries of the area of operations. It is the basic geographic element of airspace control. It can contain airspace control sub-areas.
  • CBA A cross-border area (CBA) is a temporary segregated area above an international boundary for a specified operational need. Only its designated users can fly in it.
  • DZ A drop zone (DZ) is a specified surface area onto which aircraft airdrop airborne troops, equipment or supplies. Aircraft and fires should deconflict with the drop operations.
  • EC An electromagnetic combat (EC) is airspace only for aircraft that do missions of electromagnetic combat, which is electronic warfare.
  • FACA A force air coordination area (FACA) is an area around a force in maritime operations, in which airspace control and air defence measures are necessary. The measures prevent mutual interference between all friendly surface and air units and their weapon systems.
  • HIDACZ A high-density airspace control zone (HIDACZ) is airspace of defined dimensions that the airspace control authority designates. In it, many different weapons and airspace users operate in a concentrated volume. Aircraft coordinate their entry with its controlling authority.
  • LZ A landing zone (LZ) is a zone that aircraft use for landing.
  • NFZ A no-fly zone (NFZ) is a zone of airspace of defined dimensions for specified functions. In it, no aircraft may operate, unless the enforcing authority authorizes the operation.
  • PZ A pickup zone (PZ) is an aerial retrieval area, in which aircraft pick up personnel or materiel.
  • RECCE A reconnaissance area (RECCE) is airspace only for aircraft that do reconnaissance.
  • ROZ A restricted operating zone (ROZ) is airspace of defined dimensions that the airspace control authority designates for a given situation or operational need. Examples are refuelling orbits, holding, fires and landing or drop zones. It restricts the operation of one or more airspace users in it.
  • SSMS A surface-to-surface missile system (SSMS) is airspace for the launch and impact points of the Army Tactical Missile System and of surface-launched cruise missiles. It keeps aircraft out of the flight path of the missiles.
  • TRA A temporary reserved area (TRA) is a defined volume of airspace that one airspace authority usually controls. By common agreement, it is temporarily for another airspace authority. Other air traffic may transit it only with air traffic control (ATC) clearance.
  • TSA A temporary segregated area (TSA) is airspace of defined dimensions for the exclusive use of specified users. Their tasks make this necessary. It is for a set period, and no other traffic uses the airspace.
  • TRNG A training area (TRNG) is a geographical area that is temporarily or permanently for education and training, which includes exercises and testing. It can include airspace.
  • UAA An unmanned aircraft area (UAA) is airspace of defined dimensions, only for unmanned aircraft operations.
  • ADIZ An air defence identification zone (ADIZ) is airspace of defined dimensions in which the identification, location and control of aircraft is immediately necessary.
  • BDZ A base defence zone (BDZ) is airspace around a base that increases the effectiveness of its air defence systems. Transit routes should avoid it.
  • CADA A coordinated air defence area (CADA) is a block of airspace that a land-based air commander and a naval commander agree together. They agree it when their forces operate close to each other. It sets the limits of their air defence responsibilities.
  • FEZ A fighter engagement zone (FEZ) is airspace of defined dimensions in which the engagement of air threats is normally the task of fighter aircraft. This definition is for air defence.
  • WFZ A weapons free zone (WFZ) is an air defence zone that gives protection to important assets or facilities, other than airbases. In it, air defence weapon systems may fire at any target without positive identification as friendly. Transit routes should avoid it.
  • CCZONE A carrier control zone (CCZONE) is an area around an aircraft carrier that operates fixed-wing or rotary-wing aircraft. The carrier controls the area for carrier flight operations.
  • COZ A crossover zone (COZ) is airspace beyond the missile engagement zone (MEZ) of a maritime force. Air defence fighters may go into it only in hot pursuit of targets, to complete an interception. The fighters give a countdown of the seconds until the engagement.
  • SAFES A safety sector (SAFES) is a sector that routes friendly aircraft to maritime forces with minimum risk. In it, friendly aircraft are safe from friendly fighters or weapons when they approach or return to the maritime force.
  • SCZ A ship control zone (SCZ) is an area activated around a ship that operates aircraft. Friendly aircraft should not go into it without permission. This prevents friendly interference.
  • ALTRV An altitude reservation (ALTRV) is a block of altitude for aircraft to transit or loiter. The altitude reservation is moving or stationary. It always has an upper and a lower limit, and it can also have lateral limits.
  • RCA A reduced coordination (RCA) is airspace of defined dimensions in which general air traffic may fly off-route. General air traffic controllers do not have to start coordination with operational air traffic controllers for these flights.
  • BZ A buffer zone (BZ) is airspace that is a buffer between coordination measures. It is an air reference measure, thus aircraft go through it without coordination.
  • JEZ A joint engagement zone (JEZ) is airspace of defined dimensions in air defence, in which more than one air defence system engages air threats. These systems are surface-to-air missiles (SAMs) and aircraft, and they engage at the same time. The OPTASK AAW sets its limits. Accurate identification and positive control are necessary, thus SAMs do not engage friendly fighters.
  • ADS An air defence sector (ADS) is a geographical subdivision of an air defence region. An air defence region is a geographical subdivision of an air defence area.

Data extension

urn:opord-builder:extension:data:1

ext-data

The org.opord-builder.data extension: variables that a ${var} or ${var/json/pointer} binding in any string of the document reads. The group is resolved and removed when the document is loaded.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
varsmap of VaryesVariable name -> source. Each variable has exactly one of path, from or value, and optionally the selectors select, where, key and map, applied in that order.

Var

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
pathstringA file, relative to this document (absolute is allowed). A path with glob characters (*, ?, [) matches files in sorted order; each is parsed and selected, then the results are combined (lists concatenate, maps merge, a duplicate key is an error).
formatenumThe file format when the suffix (.json, .yaml, .yml, .csv) does not say.
  • json
  • yaml
  • csv
validate"openaix"openaix: load the file as an OpenAIX document, bindings included.
fromstring | list of stringOne variable, or several that are combined in order (lists concatenate, maps merge, a duplicate key is an error).
valueanyA literal JSON value; it is not interpolated.
selectstringA JSON Pointer into the value; a missing pointer is an error.
whereobjectJSON Pointer -> value; keeps the items (of a list) or entries (of a map) that equal all of them.
keystringA JSON Pointer in each item of a list; turns the list into a map keyed by that value as text.
mapstring | map of stringA JSON Pointer (project each item to that sub-value) or field -> JSON Pointer (project each item to a record).

Kneeboard extension

urn:opord-builder:extension:kneeboard:1

ext-kneeboard

The org.opord-builder.kneeboard extension: kneeboard cards, or overrides of the card built from an ATO flight. On a flight, a card with no flight_callsign applies to that flight.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
cardslist of KneeboardCard

KneeboardATCEntry

Single ATC / control agency frequency entry.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
namestringAgency name (e.g. 'MARSHAL', 'TOWER', 'DEPARTURE', 'AI CV CONTROLLER').
frequencystringFrequency with optional button (e.g. '241.600 MHz (BTN 19)').

KneeboardCard

A single kneeboard card for DCS World (768×1024 PNG) or print. Captures the tactical data a pilot needs on the knee: flight lineup, comms plan, fuel plan, objectives, tanker info, and ATC frequencies. Values can reference OPORD/FRAGO variables via Jinja2 interpolation.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
titlestringCard title / header line (defaults to flight_callsign if blank).
flight_callsignstringFlight callsign (e.g. 'LINER32').
msn_numberstringMission or serial number.
positionslist of KneeboardPositionAircraft positions in the flight (lead, wingmen).
tacanKneeboardTACANTACAN channel plan.
timingKneeboardTimingPackage time on target and push.
primary_objectiveslist of stringPrimary mission objectives.
secondary_objectiveslist of stringSecondary mission objectives.
weaponeeringstringWeaponeering notes / loadout.
fuel_planKneeboardFuelPlanFuel planning figures.
commsKneeboardCommsPlanCommunications plan by phase.
tankerslist of KneeboardTankerTanker assignments.
atclist of KneeboardATCEntryATC / control agency frequencies.
baro_altstringBarometric altimeter setting (e.g. '29.92').
iffstringIFF line of the flight: mode 1, mode 4 and mode C. Mode 3 is per position.
weatherstringOne line of weather for the mission: clouds, visibility and surface wind of the forecast that covers it.
notesstringFreeform notes.
steerpointslist of KneeboardSteerpointThe route as steerpoints.

KneeboardCommsPhase

Radio assignments for one mission phase.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
phasestringPhase name (e.g. 'DECK OPS', 'REJOIN', 'PUSH', 'EGRESS', 'RECOVERY').
comm1stringCOMM 1 radio assignment for this phase.
comm2stringCOMM 2 radio assignment for this phase.

KneeboardCommsPlan

Complete communications plan for the kneeboard card.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
phaseslist of KneeboardCommsPhaseRadio assignments by mission phase.
intrastringIntraflight frequency (e.g. '276.500 MHz').
midsstringMIDS / Link-16 assignment.

KneeboardFuelPlan

Fuel planning figures in pounds.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
msn_req_lbsintegerMission-required fuel in pounds.
joker_lbsintegerJoker fuel state in pounds.
bingo_lbsintegerBingo fuel state in pounds.
rcv_tank_lbsintegerReceive-tank fuel in pounds (carrier ops).

KneeboardPosition

Single aircraft position within a flight.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
numberintegerPosition in flight (1 = lead, 2 = wingman, etc.).
modexstringAircraft modex / side number (e.g. '420').
persstringPilot name, initials, or callsign.
laserstringLaser PRF code (4-digit, e.g. '1781').
mode3stringIFF mode 3 code of the position (4 digits).

KneeboardTACAN

TACAN channel plan for the flight.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
leadstringLead TACAN channel (e.g. '14Y').
flightstringFlight common TACAN channel (e.g. '77Y').

KneeboardTanker

Tanker information entry.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
callsignstringTanker callsign (e.g. 'SHELL21').
frequencystringTanker primary frequency (e.g. '240.100 MHz').
tacanstringTanker TACAN channel (e.g. '41Y').
buttonstringRadio button/preset reference (e.g. 'BTN 16').

KneeboardTiming

Package timing figures for the flight.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
totstringTime on target (e.g. '1030Z', '1030Z-1045Z', 'NLT 1045Z').
pushstringPush time (e.g. '0950Z').
push_pointstringName of the push point.

KneeboardSteerpoint

One steerpoint of the route.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
numberintegerSteerpoint number: the route point's number, else its position in the route from 1.

mgrsstringPosition as MGRS.

Measure extension

ext-measure

The org.opord-builder.measure extension on a control measure: the catalogue code of a measure whose type has none (AXIS, CFZ, SFA, RFZ, SAR, DZ/LZ/PZ, MRR), and the authoring fields of a data-source entry that the typed measure does not carry.

codestringThe control-measure code the authoring model used; only on a measure of type org.opord-builder.measure.

Order extension

urn:opord-builder:extension:order:1

ext-order

The org.opord-builder.order extension: the paragraph content of an order that OpenAIX has no typed field for. It mirrors the paragraphs of the order, and annexes sit under their letter.

document_kindenumwarno marks a warning order. Absent for an OPORD.
  • warno

AARTrack

Named Air-to-Air Refueling track. Tanker assignments to the track are made in FRAGOs; the OPORD publishes the enduring geometry + radios.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
namestringTrack designator (e.g. 'TRACK ARCO', 'TRACK SHELL').
anchor_primarystringPrimary anchor coordinates.
anchor_secondarystringSecondary anchor (end of track for racetrack tracks).
track_headingintegerTrack heading in degrees true (when not defined by two anchors).
track_length_nmnumberTrack length in nautical miles.
altitude_floor_ftintegerAltitude block floor (feet MSL).
altitude_ceiling_ftintegerAltitude block ceiling (feet MSL).
refueling_methodenumBoom, drogue, or both (track-dependent).
  • BOOM
  • DROGUE
  • BOTH
tanker_types_supportedlist of stringAirframes that can occupy this track (e.g. 'KC-135R', 'KC-46A', 'KC-130J', 'S-3B').
tacan_channelstringTrack TACAN channel (e.g. '63Y').
primary_freqstringPrimary track frequency.
secondary_freqstringBackup / boom-talk frequency.
active_dtg_startstringMilitary date-time group in DDHHMMZMONYY form (e.g. '181200ZAPR26').
active_dtg_endstringMilitary date-time group in DDHHMMZMONYY form (e.g. '181200ZAPR26').

AICSector

Air Intercept Controller sector — sub-sector inside an AWACS orbit's coverage, assigned to a named controller.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
sector_namestringSector designator (e.g. 'SECTOR NORTH', 'RED 1').
controller_callsignstringController callsign.
responsible_geographystringSector definition (e.g. '090-180 from BULLSEYE, 0-200nm, 0-45000ft').
primary_freqstringSector primary frequency.
secondary_freqstringBackup frequency.
reports_tostringParent AWACS callsign this controller reports to.

ASCOPEEntry

An entry in the ASCOPE register per ATP 3-57.60.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
categoryenumASCOPE category.
  • AREAS
  • STRUCTURES
  • CAPABILITIES
  • ORGANIZATIONS
  • PEOPLE
  • EVENTS
namestringEntry name or label.
descriptionstringNarrative description of the entry.
gridstringMilitary Grid Reference System (MGRS) grid; 2-, 4-, 6-, 8-, or 10-digit precision. Examples: '38SMB4578', '38SMB45780789'.
significancestringOperational significance — why the entry matters to the mission.

AWACSOrbit

Persistent AWACS / airborne-C2 orbit. Daily ATO tasks specific airframes into these orbits; the OPORD publishes the station framework.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
callsignstringAWACS callsign (e.g. 'MAGIC', 'OVERLORD', 'DARKSTAR').
platformstringAirframe (e.g. 'E-3G Sentry', 'E-2D Hawkeye', 'KJ-2000').
orbit_centerstringOrbit center coordinates.
orbit_radius_nmnumberOrbit radius in nautical miles.
altitude_ftintegerOrbit altitude (feet MSL).
on_station_dtgstringMilitary date-time group in DDHHMMZMONYY form (e.g. '181200ZAPR26').
off_station_dtgstringMilitary date-time group in DDHHMMZMONYY form (e.g. '181200ZAPR26').
sector_of_responsibilitystringPrimary airspace sector covered.
primary_freqstringPrimary control frequency.
datalink_channelstringLink-16 channel / MIDS net / DCS datalink ID.
owns_bullseyestringBullseye GeoRef name this orbit publishes (matches a GeoRef entry).

AirspaceControl

Stable airspace architecture published in Annex C Operations. FRAGOs reference these by name when tasking sorties into specific tracks, stations, or zones — the OPORD publishes geometry, radios, and controller callsigns once and FRAGOs consume them by reference.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
geo_refsmap of GeoRef | list of GeoRefExtra fields of each item, keyed by the identifier of the OpenAIX item; or the whole list when the list has no OpenAIX counterpart.
airspace_zonesmap of AirspaceZone | list of AirspaceZoneExtra fields of each item, keyed by the identifier of the OpenAIX item; or the whole list when the list has no OpenAIX counterpart.
cap_tracksmap of CAPTrack | list of CAPTrackExtra fields of each item, keyed by the identifier of the OpenAIX item; or the whole list when the list has no OpenAIX counterpart.
aar_tracksmap of AARTrack | list of AARTrackExtra fields of each item, keyed by the identifier of the OpenAIX item; or the whole list when the list has no OpenAIX counterpart.
awacs_orbitslist of AWACSOrbitPersistent AWACS / airborne-C2 orbits with callsign, platform, orbit center, and station window.
aic_sectorslist of AICSectorAir Intercept Controller sub-sectors inside AWACS coverage, each with a named controller and freq.
ingress_corridorsmap of MinimumRiskRoute | list of MinimumRiskRouteExtra fields of each item, keyed by the identifier of the OpenAIX item; or the whole list when the list has no OpenAIX counterpart.

AirspaceZone

Published airspace zone with a single `kind` discriminator covering ROZ / HIDACZ / weapon engagement zones / no-fly / SAR / safe areas. Shape is either a circle (anchor + radius) or a polygon (ordered vertex list).

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
namestringZone designator (e.g. 'ROZ HAMMER', 'MEZ NORTH', 'NFZ ALTENSTADT').
kindenumZone category.
  • ROZ
  • HIDACZ
  • MEZ
  • FEZ
  • JEZ
  • NFZ
  • SAR
  • SAFE
anchor_pointstringCircle anchor (coordinates); used when the zone is radial.
radius_nmnumberCircle radius in nautical miles; used with `anchor_point`.
polygon_verticeslist of stringOrdered polygon vertices (coordinate strings); used when the zone is non-circular.
altitude_floor_ftintegerFloor altitude (feet MSL).
altitude_ceiling_ftintegerCeiling altitude (feet MSL).
active_dtg_startstringMilitary date-time group in DDHHMMZMONYY form (e.g. '181200ZAPR26').
active_dtg_endstringMilitary date-time group in DDHHMMZMONYY form (e.g. '181200ZAPR26').
purposestringShort purpose statement (e.g. 'CAS stack over OBJ HAMMER').
engagement_rulesstringWEZ variants only — engagement authority/constraints (e.g. 'Patriot missile layer; fighters stay above 25000ft').

AmbulanceExchangePoint

An Ambulance Exchange Point (AXP) where casualty handoff occurs between evac assets.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
axp_namestringAXP designator (e.g. 'AXP BLUE').

established_nltstringDTG by which the AXP must be operational.
comms_netstringRadio net used to coordinate casualty handoff at this AXP.

CDEGuidance

Collateral Damage Estimation guidance block per CJCSI 3160.01. Published in Annex D (Fires) so the CDE level referenced on every JPITL, TST, HPTL, and 9-line CAS entry ties back to a single operation-wide definition of levels, engagement authorities, weaponeering methodology, LOAC review authority, and No-Strike / Restricted Target List references.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
levelslist of CDELevelDefinitionPer-level CDE definitions. Typically all five levels are included with doctrinal text so readers understand each reference.
commanders_guidancestringCommander's narrative guidance on CDE posture for this operation (e.g. 'favor precision delivery; CDE-3 default for all dynamic targeting').
weaponeering_methodologystringWeaponeering methodology in use (e.g. 'JMEM', 'Precision Strike Suite (PSS-SOF) v6.1').
loac_review_authoritystringLOAC review authority for target packets at CDE-3 and above (e.g. 'CJTF SJA', 'OSJA').
no_strike_list_referencestringCurrent No-Strike List (NSL) version/date in effect for this operation.
restricted_target_list_referencestringCurrent Restricted Target List (RTL) version/date in effect for this operation.
documentation_requirementslist of stringCommon documentation expected on every target-approval packet (target folder, imagery, PID evidence, weaponeering worksheet, CDE worksheet, LOAC review memo).
additional_notesstringAdditional CDE-related policy or notes specific to this operation (dynamic-targeting abort authorities, NGO proximity policies, etc.).

CDELevelDefinition

One row defining a Collateral Damage Estimation level per CJCSI 3160.01.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
levelenumCDE level identifier (CDE-1 through CDE-5).
  • CDE-1
  • CDE-2
  • CDE-3
  • CDE-4
  • CDE-5
namestringShort doctrinal name (e.g. 'Target Validation', 'Casualty Estimation').
descriptionstringWhat this CDE step entails and the conditions under which it applies.
engagement_authoritystringBaseline engagement-approval echelon for this level (e.g. 'BN CDR', 'JFLCC', 'CJCS/SECDEF').
documentation_requiredlist of stringDocumentation required to satisfy this level (imagery, target folder, weaponeering worksheet, LOAC review).

purposestringThe broader purpose of the operation — the 'why' beyond the mission statement's immediate purpose.
key_taskslist of stringActivities the force must perform as a whole to achieve the end state; not specified tasks to subordinates.
end_statestringThe desired conditions at operation's end. Per ADP 5-0, expressed in terms of friendly, enemy, terrain, and civil conditions.
end_state_friendlystringDesired condition of friendly forces at end state (the 'friendly' category per ADP 5-0).
end_state_enemystringDesired condition of enemy forces at end state (the 'enemy' category per ADP 5-0).

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
open_door_policystringStatement of the commander's open-door policy.
primary_channelenumPrimary complaint channel.
  • chain_of_command
  • nco_support_channel
  • ig_direct
submission_methodslist of stringAccepted submission methods (in person, form, email, phone, hotline).
acknowledgement_timelinestringTimeline for acknowledging receipt of a complaint.
confidentiality_and_reprisal_protectionstringStatement of confidentiality and protection from reprisal.

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
overviewstringHigh-level narrative of how the operation will unfold from start to end state.
maneuverstringOverall maneuver concept tying decisive, shaping, and sustaining operations together.
decisive_operationstringThe operation that directly accomplishes the mission; the main effort at the decisive point per ADP 3-0.
shaping_operationsstringOperations that create and preserve conditions for success of the decisive operation.
sustaining_operationsstringOperations that enable the decisive and shaping operations by generating and maintaining combat power.
reservestringComposition, location, priorities, and planned employment of the reserve.

termination_dtgstringMilitary date-time group in DDHHMMZMONYY form (e.g. '181200ZAPR26').

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
effective_timestringDTG at which the order becomes effective (often 'On receipt' or a specific DTG).
ccirCCIRCommander's Critical Information Requirements (PIR and FFIR).
eefilist of stringEssential Elements of Friendly Information — information about friendly forces that must be protected from adversary collection.

acmstringAirspace Coordinating Measures (e.g. ROZ, ACA, UA) in effect for the operation.
roestringRules of Engagement applicable to the operation; typically references a SROE/MROE annex or card.
risk_reduction_control_measuresstringControl measures used to mitigate tactical and accidental risks identified in the risk assessment per ATP 5-19.
personnel_recoverystringPersonnel Recovery (PR) guidance: isolated personnel reporting, authentication, and recovery procedures.

themes_and_messageslist of stringApproved themes and messages that subordinate units reinforce through word and deed.

9-Line CAS brief — structured tactical brief passed from JTAC/FAC(A) to CAS aircraft per JP 3-09.3 / AFTTP 3-2.6. Line order follows doctrinal format: IP → heading → distance → target elevation → target description → target location → mark → friendlies → egress. Remarks follow after line 9 (threats, hazards, laser code, TOT, danger-close ground-commander initials, terminal-control type).

  • L
  • R

target_elevation_ftintegerTarget elevation in feet MSL.
target_descriptionstringTarget type and configuration (e.g. '3x T-72 tanks in hasty defense vic tree line').
target_locationstringTarget location — MGRS, L/L, or offset from IP (bearing/distance). Match the format in use for the AO.
mark_typeenumHow the target will be marked for the aircraft.
  • LASER
  • IR_POINTER
  • SMOKE
  • WP
  • GOGGLES
  • FLARE
  • NONE
laser_codestring4-digit laser PRF code (e.g. '1688') when mark_type is LASER.

friendlies_directionstringDirection from target to friendlies (cardinal or octant, e.g. 'N', 'SW').
friendlies_markingstringHow friendlies are marked (VS-17 panel, IR strobe, chemlight color, smoke, etc.).
egressstringEgress direction / instructions after weapons release (e.g. 'SOUTH LOW', 'TRACK NORTH TO IP ALPHA').
final_attack_headingintegerFinal Attack Heading (FAH) in degrees magnetic, if restricted for deconfliction or terrain.
time_on_targetstringMilitary date-time group in DDHHMMZMONYY form (e.g. '181200ZAPR26').
time_to_target_minintegerTime To Target (TTT) in minutes from push, if a relative timing is in use instead of TOT.
type_of_controlenumCAS terminal control type per JP 3-09.3 (Type 1/2/3).
  • TYPE_1
  • TYPE_2
  • TYPE_3
control_agencystringControlling JTAC / FAC(A) callsign (e.g. 'DAGGER 11', 'VIPER 11 FAC(A)').
cas_callsignstringCAS flight callsign being briefed (e.g. 'UZI 11 flight of 2 F-16C').
threatslist of stringKnown or suspected threats in the target area (SA-13, ZU-23-2, MANPADS, etc.).
hazardslist of stringWeather, terrain, or artificial hazards (low ceilings, wires, balloons, restricted airspace).

Weather

Paragraph 1.b.(2) Weather — five military aspects, light, forecast, climate, effects. Per FM 6-0 (May 2022) Appendix D and ATP 2-01.3 Ch 3, the weather sub-paragraph must cover the five military aspects of weather (visibility, winds, precipitation, cloud cover, temperature/humidity), a light table, AND for multi-day operations a forecast keyed to phases or days — a single snapshot is insufficient for campaign- scale OPORDs. `effects_on_operations captures the doctrinally required 'so what' analysis. climate_baseline` provides the seasonal norm when the forecast confidence is low or the AO is unfamiliar. The SWO / tactical weather team produces the underlying Staff Weather Product; this paragraph is the executive summary with the tables typically living in Annex B (Intelligence).

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
visibilitystringVisibility conditions and effects on operations (fog, haze, obscurants, illumination limits).
windsstringSurface and aloft winds with effects on aviation, fires, smoke, and CBRN employment.
precipitationstringExpected precipitation type, intensity, and effects on mobility, optics, and soldier load.
cloud_coverstringCeiling and cloud coverage with effects on aviation, ISR, and close air support.
temperature_and_humiditystringTemperature and humidity ranges with effects on personnel, equipment, and heat/cold casualty risk.
climate_baselinestringSeasonal/regional climatology baseline for the AO (prevailing winds, precipitation norms, temperature bands). Used as the reference against which the operation-period forecast is compared; most useful for unfamiliar AOs or operations > 72 hrs.
forecast_confidencestringForecast confidence level (LOW / MODERATE / HIGH) with rationale — drives branch planning around weather-dependent assets.
swo_product_referencestringPointer to the authoritative SWO / tactical weather team product (e.g. 'Annex B, App 1, Tab B (Weather), SWO Product 26-04-WX-015').
forecastslist of WeatherNoteFree text of each forecast of the typed forecasts, by position (a forecast has no identifier). Fills a table cell where the forecast has no typed value, and is printed beside one that has.
light_datamap of objectExtra fields of each day of the typed light_data, keyed by its date.

windsstringWind forecast with effects.
precipitationstringPrecipitation forecast with effects.
cloud_coverstringCloud cover / ceiling forecast with effects.
temperature_and_humiditystringTemperature (Hi/Lo) and humidity for this period.
